coffees.title: Africa Boda Boda SWP Decaf

coffees.title: Bolivia Illimani Gesha
coffees.description: Brews a clean Gesha cup, with elegant sweetness accented by aromatic hints of fragrant teas, chamomile flower, jasmine pearl suggestions, and acidity has a soft citric dimension. Light roasts recommended. City to City+.

coffees.title: Brazil Dry Process Alta da Serra
coffees.subregion: Sao Sebastiao do Paraiso, Minas Gerais
coffees.description: Low intensity cup, deep-toned cocoa bittering, nutty accents, mild acidity and creamy body. Makes a very nice espresso option in the mid-to-dark roasts. Full City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Brazil Dry Process Canastra Luis Otavio
coffees.description: Robust bittersweetness, nutty accents of hazelnut syrup, caramel nut, and chocolate-covered peanuts, with rustic cocoa, chocolate malted grains, and a hint of toasted barley tea. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Brazil Dry Process Donésio Silvério
coffees.description: Creamy Brazil cup, cocoa and nut toned, with bittersweetness that will pair nicely with milk. Notes of sorghum syrup, walnut, dried fruit hint, cedar smoke in the long finish. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Brazil Dry Process Doña Dalila
coffees.description: Velvety body and low acidity help convey dark-toned flavors that are richly bittersweet. Notes of dark chocolate bar, bittering torte, and baking cocoa in the long aftertaste. Full City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Brazil Dry Process Doña Maria Dorotéia
coffees.subregion: Pouso Danta, Santa Rita do Sapucaí
coffees.description: Fruited hints add interest to the rustic bittersweet roast flavors, and creamy nut accents. Chocolate pistachio, banana bread with walnuts, Sherry, nutty teas, and baking chocolate. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Brazil Dry Process Doña Maria Dorotéia
coffees.subregion: Pouso Danta, Santa Rita do Sapucaí
coffees.description: Fruited hints add interest to the bittersweet roast flavors, and creamy nut accents. Chocolate pistachio, banana bread, walnut, dried berry, chocolate ganache, baking chocolate. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Brazil Dry Process Doña Marta
coffees.description: Bittersweet and creamy-textured, chocolate protein shake, intimations of amaretto, winey blackberry, raw pistachio nut, almond milk, Matcha powder, rustic cocoa, and hint of spiced rum. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Brazil Dry Process Patrocinio Fazenda Paraiso
coffees.subregion: Carmo do Paranaiba, Patrocinio, Minas Gerais
coffees.description: Roast intensity pairs well with big body and mildly present acidity. Rustic dark chocolate, raisin, puffed rice, creamy mouthfeel, with interesting accents of spice and green herbs. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Brazil Dry Process Reinaldo Gomes
coffees.description: Fruit and nut toned cup with rustic sweetness, and fermented hints. Cocoa, dried berry, pistachio, walnut, chocolate liqueur, acetic-sweet accents of a fruit shrub drink. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Brazil Dry Process Santa Maria do Vintém
coffees.subregion: Vintém, Santa Rita do Sapucaí, Minas Geraís
coffees.description: Punchy bittersweetness cuts through milk, pleasant roast tones, substantial body, accents of dried coconut, rustic leather aroma, and smokey finish. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Brazil Dry Process Santa Maria do Vintém
coffees.subregion: Vintém, Santa Rita do Sapucaí, Minas Geraís
coffees.description: Chocolate-forward, substantial body, dark cocoa powder, coconut chips, hints of spice and dried fruit accent the core bittersweet flavors, along with just a hint of acidity. City+ to Full City+. Excellent espresso.

coffees.title: Brazil Dry Process São Joaquim Farm
coffees.subregion: Saō Sebastiaō da Bela Vista, Santanal, Mantiqueira de Minas
coffees.description: Prominent bittersweetness with notes of granola bar with chocolate chips, walnut bread, chocolate-covered almond, and creamy hazelnut spread. Great option for milk drinks. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Brazil Dry Process Sítio Três Barras
coffees.subregion: Santa Rita de Caldas, Minas Geraís
coffees.description: Deep-toned coffee with thick, oily body, and substantial cocoa flavors that pair well with cream. Chocolate bittersweets, caramel cookie with almond, saffron spice note in the finish. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Brazil Dry Process Sítio da Pedra
coffees.description: Classic bittersweet Brazil, with nutty accents, and thick body that works well for milk drinks. Brown sugar, almond taffy, puffed rice, cocoa nibs, chocolate nut bar, and baking chocolate. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Brazil Espírito Santo Fazenda Boa Vista
coffees.subregion: Espírito Santo do Pinhal, São Paulo
coffees.description: Bodied Brazil coffee, milky texture conveys bittersweet flavors and creamy nut tones. Dark drinking chocolate, nougat, raw cashew, walnut, dark chocolate almond bark, low acidity. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Brazil Fazenda IP SWP Decaf
coffees.description: Very nice analog to our regular Brazilian coffees. lnterplay of bittersweetness and creamy nut, dark cocoa roast tones, toffee peanut, almond, caramel, and hint of Root Beer. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso. *First crack is very subtle. See notes for guidance.

coffees.title: Brazil Patrocinio Fazenda Paraiso
coffees.subregion: Carmo do Paranaiba, Patrocinio, Minas Gerais
coffees.description: Roast intensity pairs well with heavy body and mildly present acidity. Rustic dark chocolate, dried cherry, marzipan, creamy mouthfeel, with accents of tamarind and roasted peanut. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Brazil Pulp Natural Condado São José
coffees.subregion: Bacaio, Santa Rita do Sacupaí, Mantiqueira, Minas Gerais
coffees.description: Pleasantly simple cup tied to bittersweetness, with subtle top note hints. Honey-nut, malted grain, sesame cookie, faint dried apple note. Great for milk drinks. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Brazil Pulp Natural Fazenda Santa Lucia
coffees.description: Low-toned, low-acidity coffee, bittersweet and nutty accents, big body, and a long finish. Hints of rustic sugars, walnut, cocoa powder, baking chocolate, leathery note. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Brazil Pulp Natural Gabriel Wagner
coffees.description: Mild flavors lean toward semi-sweet chocolate, with creamy nut accents, and low acidity. Notes of barley malt syrup, chocolate-covered nuts, dark chocolate cookie with sea salt, bittersweet finish. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Brazil Pulp Natural Patrícia Carvalho
coffees.description: Good balance for Brazil, low acidity, creamy, mild flavors of high cocoa solids dark chocolate, toasted nut, almond milk, bittersweetness sure to punch through in milk drinks. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Brazil Yellow Honey Carlos & Dani
coffees.description: Brews well at a wide roast range, and ticks off a lot of boxes for single origin espresso. Mid-toned chocolate, nutty hints, barley malt, honey granola with walnut, dried apple. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Burundi Colline Masenga
coffees.description: The profile is on the delicate and bright side for Burundi, with elegant acidity that weaves through complex raw sugar sweetness. Top notes hint at cinnamon stick, rose hips tea, and lemon. Excellent pour-over. City to City+.

coffees.title: Burundi Collines Masenga
coffees.description: We're enjoying middle roasts of Masenga, where crowd-pleasing bittersweet flavors are accented by mild top notes of spice and tea. Dark cocoa, Chai tea, woody whole cloves. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Burundi Dry Process Kibingo
coffees.description: Flavor profiles shift with roast level, from fruited light roasts to downright bittersweet and silky when roasted dark. Notes of stone fruit, berry, orange, barley malt syrup, and rustic cocoa. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Burundi Dry Process Murambi
coffees.description: Exceptional dry process Burundi, juicy notes of blackberry and blueberry, dried stone fruit, and well structured acidity. Flavors shift as the coffee cools, making it a fun one to take your time drinking. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Burundi Dry Process Nyabiraba Kinama
coffees.description: Fruit and bittersweet notes open up to complex aromatic hints. Notes dried fruits, multigrain pancakes with blueberry syrup, coriander and all spice, fermented fruit and aromatic wood. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Burundi Honey Process Masha
coffees.description: Brightly spiced cup with syrupy sweetness and subtly complex aroma. Sugar cane juice, caramel topping, Earl Grey and Sencha teas with a twist of lemon, brisk acidity, whole spice hints in the nose. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Burundi Kabarore Commune Yandaro
coffees.description: Broad sweetness of caramel and raw sugars at light roast levels, accented by hints of apple, English Breakfast tea, zested orange, bright lemon, and baking spice. Milky chocolate and dark fruit hints when roasted dark. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Burundi Kayanza Gakenke
coffees.description: Impressive Burundi that's saccharine sweet, with dynamic flavors, and refined finish. Notes of Earl Grey tea, lively citrus hints, orange peel, cocoa, and a finish framed by aromatic baking spices. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Burundi Kayanza Kibingo Station
coffees.description: Lasting raw sugar flavors lead to a brightly sweet finish, with accents of warming spices, aromatic black tea, and dried currant. Full City brews are bittersweet, mildly fruited, and syrupy. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Burundi Kiganda Murambi
coffees.description: Perfect daily driver at a wide roast range, abundant body and sweetness, aromatic hints, notes of brûlée sugar crust, goji berry, black tea with lemon, spice, dark cocoa. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Burundi Monge Murambi Hill
coffees.description: Syrupy bodied coffee with clean, bright flavors that are sweet from start to finish. Cane sugar and honey sweetness, hints of English Breakfast tea, orange essence, mouth-cleansing acidity. The complete package! City to Full City.

coffees.title: Burundi Monge Murambi Hill
coffees.description: Syrupy bodied coffee with clean, bright flavors that are sweet from start to finish. Raw sugar and honey sweetness, aromatic hints of fragrant black teas, all-spice, and pleasant tea-tannic finish. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Burundi Mutambu Migoti Hill
coffees.description: Excellent light roast brew, elegant, bright, with prevalent sweetness, and top note highlights of cherry, raw sugar, spice tea, rose hips, and a twist of lemon. Dark roasts are best for espresso. City to Full City. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Burundi Mutambu Migoti Hill
coffees.description: Elegant as it cools, layered sweetness is the focus, notes of whole spices, dried lemongrass, aromatic black tea, and moderate acidity that hints at citrus and tannic tea. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Cameroon Kouoptamo Cooperative
coffees.description: The cup is bittersweet and roast-toned, with hints of brown rice syrup, filbert nut, toasted coconut, lemon bars, earthy Matcha. A rare opportunity to try coffee from Cameroon. City+ to Full City+.

coffees.title: Colombia Buesaco Alianza Granjeros
coffees.description: A caramel-sweet center and well balanced acidity make this coffee quite the crowd pleaser. Flavors range from from burnt sugar, chocolate pistachio, with a ribbon of tangy bittersweets. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia Buesaco Alianza Granjeros
coffees.description: A caramel-sweet center and subtle hints of fruit make this coffee quite the crowd pleaser. Flavors range from from butterscotch to dried peach, with a ribbon of chocolate bittersweets. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia Buesaco EA Decaf
coffees.description: Convincing sweetness, mild brown sugar, bright fruit accents bring out positive acidic impression, hints of spice, dried green apple, bittering fruit skin, roast tones underneath. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Colombia Buesaco Jose Miguel Paz
coffees.subregion: Vereda El Retiro, San Antonio, Buesaco, Nariño
coffees.description: Delicious brewed coffee, clean fruit accents with sugary-sweet notes as its base flavor. Highlights of raisin, cooked sugar, fruit pastry with cinnamon, malic acidity, sweet finish, well-balanced flavors. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Colombia Buesaco Maricela Ordoñez
coffees.description: This microlot has great cup clarity when roasted light aromatic sweetness, caramel, nougat, bright accents of green apple, rose hips, hint of English Breakfast tea, sweetly refined finish. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Colombia Buesaco Rio Juanambú
coffees.description: Centered around a balanced interplay of caramelized sugar sweetness and bittering cocoa, with notes of salted caramel, whole spice, and hint of rindy citrus. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia Buesaco Río Juanambú
coffees.description: Centered around a balanced interplay of caramelized sugar sweetness and low-toned bittering, with accents of salted caramel, roasted nut, cinnamon, drinking chocolate. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia Caicedo Rubén Darío Gómez
coffees.description: Fragrant sweetness accented by bracingly bright acidity that has lime-like dimension. Opens up to aromatic notes of black tea, candied lemon rind, honey-sweet finish, and pleasantly tannic mouthfeel. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Colombia Cajamarca Alexander Mancilla
coffees.description: Pleasantly mild Colombian coffee, and a lot of folks will find the lower level of acidity welcoming. Rustic dark chocolate, savory-sweet and nutty notes, earthy hints of herbs and fresh cut wood. City+ to Full City+.

coffees.title: Colombia China Alta Geraldine Buitrago
coffees.description: Layered sweetness, mild acidity, tangy bittersweet notes, and nutty accents. Dark roasts make a great option for milk drinks, and espresso. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia China Alta Jose Buitrago
coffees.description: I found myself savoring the interplay of complex sweetness and flash of acidity that brightens the cup. Notes of brown sugar, burnt caramel, lemon, malted chocolate, cinnamon bark tea. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Colombia China Alta Reinaldo Parra
coffees.description: Sweetness resonates in the cup, with a spot of acidity that has malic apple appeal. Caramelized sugar, coffee cake, pecan bar, cinnamon, and hint of citrus. Dark roast friendly, with big bittersweetness! City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia Dos Productores Chiroso Variety
coffees.description: Uniquely aromatic with layered sweetness and delicate top notes. Dark caramel and aromatic sugars, tangy tea notes of red rooibos, chamomile flower, and Earl Grey, hints of zested orange, and cinnamon roll. City to City+.

coffees.title: Colombia Double Ferment Huila Pacamara
coffees.description: An extended "double" fermentation process yields interesting fruit flavors, slightly winey like brandied fruit, with notes of canned pear, peach rings, sorghum syrup, bittersweet undertones, and syrupy body. City to City+.

coffees.title: Colombia Edward Sandoval Chiroso
coffees.description: Light roasts are ideal, highlighting a delicate aromatic profile, with fragrant sweetness and high toned complexity. Look for notes of panela, honey, juicy acidity, hibiscus flower tea, cherry, dried mango, and more! City to City+.

coffees.title: Colombia Edward Sandoval Gesha
coffees.description: A uniquely fruited Gesha coffee, with aromatic florals up top that bring a freshness to the cup. Hints of jasmine and honeysuckle flowers, honey, star fruit, apple cider, lemon, and mango green tea. City to City+.

coffees.title: Colombia Edward Sandoval Wush Wush
coffees.description: Refined sweetness, sparkling acidity, juicy fruit accents, elegant aromatics...this coffee is the complete package! Notes of honey, rapadura, tropical fruit, tangerine, citrusy hops, rose petal tea. City to City+.

coffees.title: Colombia Edward Sandoval Wush Wush
coffees.description: Refined sweetness, clean acidity, juicy fruit accents, delicate aromatics...the complete package! Notes of honey, rapadura-type sugars, mango, tangerine, and elegant hints of floral hops, and rose petal tea. City to City+.

coffees.title: Colombia El Mirador Pink Bourbon
coffees.description: The cup has tart acidity, with resolute sweetness that pushes through in the aftertaste, an amalgam of raw sugars and honey, hints of green apple, dried apricot, with a lemon note that ties things together. City to City+.

coffees.title: Colombia El Virgel Carlos Emilio Chiroso
coffees.description: Strong showing of sweetness accented by delicate top notes, juicy acidity, and a spiced finish. Notes of honey, molasses, pear, berry, chamomile tea, and woody whole cardamom. City to City+.

coffees.title: Colombia Granjeros de Huila Bourbon
coffees.description: Fruited tones are evident in this Bourbon coffee, resolving to a juicy, dark berry-toned cup, with spice accent, and a slight winey note in the nose. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Colombia Honey Aponte El Páramo
coffees.subregion: Vereda El Páramo, Aponte, Tablón de Gomez, Nariño
coffees.description: Robust core bittersweetness suspends fruited accents nicely in the profile. Hints of juicy plum, dried tamarind, a bright tangerine note, and dense dark chocolate flavors. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia Honey Aponte Hugo Agreda
coffees.description: Such a big honey process cup, heavy-handed fruit flavors, pulpy berries, pie filling, canned plum, wild berry wine, cranberry sauce, rustic rhubarb, compelling body, bittersweet aftertaste. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Colombia Honey Aponte Javier Janamejoy
coffees.description: Underscored by dark toned flavors, the profile opens up to tangy hints of dried fruits, baking spices, and dense body that leads to a very long finish. Date sugar, dried stone fruit, cinnamon, cocoa powder. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Colombia Honey Aponte Jorge Janamejoy
coffees.subregion: Vereda El Páramo, Aponte, Tablón de Gomez, Nariño
coffees.description: Heavy body carries flavors of raw sugar and dried fruited sweetness, with notes of molasses, panela, tangy dried apricot, golden date, and raisin bread with cinnamon. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Colombia Honey Aponte Laureano Martinez
coffees.description: There's a fruited underlay to this honey process coffee that butts up against bittersweet intensity the darker you roast it. Hints of natural dried stone fruits, fruit pastry, cacao nibs, bodied, mild acidity. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Colombia Honey Process Aponte
coffees.description: Very nice light and dark roasted, fruit accented low tones, thick body, juicier than expected, notes of dried orange, raisin, sorghum syrup, intense dark chocolate, long bittersweet aftertaste. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia Honey Vereda El Paramo
coffees.subregion: Vereda El Páramo, Aponte, Tablón de Gomez, Nariño
coffees.description: Robust core bittersweetness suspends fruited accents nicely in the profile. Hints of cooked berry, dried tamarind, a bright hint of orange, and dense dark chocolate flavors. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia Honey Vereda San Francisco
coffees.subregion: Vereda San Francisco, Aponte, Tablón de Gomez, Nariño
coffees.description: A nice composite of natural sugar sweetness and sticky fruit accents, with opaque body that lends to a long finish. Notes of sorghum syrup, dried date, hibiscus, citrus peel, coriander, and cocoa. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Colombia Huila EA Decaf
coffees.description: Sweetly balanced with hints of fruit that lend to a lively acidic impression for decaf coffee. Notes of barley malt, honey, fresh green apple, cinnamon, cocoa powder. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia Huila La Argentina
coffees.description: Versatile Colombia, from mid-toned semi-sweet chocolate and tarry burnt sugars, to intense cocoa roast flavors and thick body when roasted dark. Great coffee for milk drinks. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia Huila La Argentina
coffees.description: A special extended-fermentation seems to have imbued this coffee with fruit flavors that are uniquely aromatic. Red fruits and berries, pomegranate, spiced cider, and more. City to City+.

coffees.title: Colombia Inzá Agua Blanca
coffees.description: The type of sweet, clean flavor profile I look to for my morning brew, and guaranteed to pull me back for a second cup! Raw sugar cane, cream caramel, toffee, vanilla, orange hint, balanced acidity. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Colombia Inzá Cresta El Hato
coffees.description: Crowd pleasing sweetness, with balanced acidity that can be rounded off with roast. Malt syrup, light brown sugar, dried apple, whole spices, toasted grain, and dark cocoa roast tones. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia Inzá El Tabor
coffees.description: The kind of crowd pleasing profile I find myself reaching for again and again, rounded sweetness and well balanced, versatile in both roast range and brew methods. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia Inzá Maximino Cuchumbe
coffees.description: Honey-sweet cup with bright fruit accents, and elegant aroma. Multi-layered sweetness of clover honey, whole cane sugar, simple syrup, with hints of orange, Asian pear, persimmon, and hops. City to City+.

coffees.title: Colombia Inzá Rio Páez
coffees.description: Caramelized sugar sweetness with accents of oatmeal-raisin cookie, brown sugar, cinnamon, and apple. Dark roasts develop fudgy bittersweets, and hints of dark fruit. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia Inzá Vereda Belén
coffees.description: Driven by balanced sweetness, caramel to butterscotch, dark sugar notes, aromatic spice, hints of dried currant, raisin, and background bittersweetness in the long finish. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia Inzá Vereda San Antonio
coffees.description: Pronounced sweetness in the brew, with a lively bright side at the lighter levels. Raw sugar and honey-sweetened tea, top note accents that are tempered by balanced bittersweetness. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Colombia Inzá Veredas Vecinas
coffees.description: Light roasts show persistent sweetness, honey, sugar cane, brightly accented by juicy fruits. Full City+ roasts are freighted with chocolate roast tones, and a tasty dried fruit counterpoint. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia Inzá Veredas Vecinas
coffees.description: Light roasts show persistent sweetness, brightly accented by golden raisin and lemon essence. Full City develops a low-toned, bittersweet coffee, with profiles of rich chocolate torte, and dried date. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia La Plata Raul Hector
coffees.subregion: Alto San Francisco, La Plata, Huila
coffees.description: Balanced core flavors are so satisfying in the middle roasts, brown sugars juxtaposed by roast-toned bittering, hints of dried fruit, coconut, almond oil, ample acidity, and sweetly disappearing finish. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Colombia Leonardo Henao Gesha
coffees.description: Stick to City roast level, no darker! That's where acidity really pops, and cup sweetness is impacted by delicate perfumed aroma. Honey, tangy lemonade, jasmine and lavender hints, brisk finish like black tea. City.

coffees.title: Colombia Leonardo Henao Gesha
coffees.description: Such an elegant, floral Gesha coffee, clean and bright, and shows best when roasted light. Refined sweetness, delicate aroma, perfumed florals like jasmine pearls, Earl Grey, and citrus blossom, brisk acidity. Excellent pour over. City roast.

coffees.title: Colombia Oporapa Pink Bourbon
coffees.description: Syrupy sweet flavors and articulate fruited acidity are part of what makes this Pink Bourbon stand out. It made an excellent pour-over, showing aspects of red honey, cane juice, pear, lemon, and brisk tea. City to City+.

coffees.title: Colombia Pequeñas Granjas EA Decaf
coffees.description: A pleasant daily drinker with hints of molasses and raw nuts, cinnamon toast, sweet-savory baked goods, cocoa, malted milk powder, and body that thickens as it cools. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia Pitalito El Mirador Caturra
coffees.description: Crowd-pleasing bittersweet tones in the middle roasts, caramel-accented chocolates, cocoa powder, and the tangy bittering of dark chocolate. Great coffee for immersion brewing. City+ to Full CIty+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia Productores de Buesaco
coffees.description: This small producer blend from Buesaco has made such a well-rounded brewed coffee, toffee and creamy caramel sweetness accented by notes of baked apple, pear butter, milk chocolate, and juicy acidity. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Colombia Productores de Pitalito
coffees.description: Crowd-pleasing bittersweet tones in the middle roasts, caramel-accented chocolate, malted cocoa powder, dried orange, hazelnut, and moderate level of acidity. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia Samaria Farm EA Decaf
coffees.description: Caramel notes, banana bread with walnuts, brown sugar, malty accents, chocolate marble loaf, hints of whole grains and carob in the finish. Moderate acidity for decaf. City to Full City+. Great decaf espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia San Antonio Doña Rosa
coffees.description: This limited release offers fruited hints in light roasts, delicate and bright, and honeyed sweetness that builds to the finish. Notes of honey comb, panela, blackberry tea, golden raisin, tannic bittering on the palate. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Colombia San Antonio EA Decaf
coffees.description: Convincing sweetness and moderate acidity make it difficult to peg as decaf. A nice interplay of bitter and sweet flavors fade to notes of rustic sugars, cocoa, and a hint of apple. City to Full City. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia Tolima China Alta
coffees.description: Laced with notes of unrefined sugars, caramel, candied walnut, apple, dried persimmons, and tea-like tannic bittering. Dark roasts pull out low-toned cocoa and hints of berry. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Colombia Urrao La Despensa Chiroso
coffees.description: Potent sweetness and unique aromatics are hallmarks of Chiroso coffee. Notes of rapadura sugar, pressed cane juice, tea-like notes of Earl Grey, and chamomile, with juicy hints of grape and cranberry. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Anaerobic Cristian Alvarez
coffees.description: Wild and wooly flavors are fruity and intense, with fermented accents that bring out profiles unique to anaerobic coffee. Berry balsamic, Belgian beer, pungent green spices, honey mead, rustic bittersweets. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Anaerobic Dry Process Higuito
coffees.description: Intense anaerobic profile with rustic, fermented aroma. Winey fruit flavors are juxtaposed by a bittersweet backdrop layer. Notes of honey mead, burnt sugar, Lemoncello, Port wine, tobacco, rustic dark cocoa. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Anaerobic Finca Arecas
coffees.description: A bittersweet refrain keeps wilder accent notes feeling proportional compared to the rest, especially as you pass the City+ roast level. Dark chocolate rum cake, cherry cordial, palo santo, tobacco. City+ to Full City+.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Black Honey Reina Elizabeth
coffees.description: Fruit-accented sweetness in light roasts, agave, dried apricot, fruit tea infusions, rustic cocoa, brisk acidity. Surprisingly syrupy dark roast too, Belgian dark chocolate, cacao nibs, stone fruit. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Cerro Alto La Union
coffees.description: Medium roasts offer crowd pleasing flavors of dark cocoa and caramel, mild acidity, and hints of tea, woody whole spices, and marbled chocolate cake. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Chirripo Finca Jose
coffees.subregion: Chirripo National Park, La Piedra de Rivas
coffees.description: Centered around sweetness and roast tones, with restrained top notes that bring a subtle complexity to the cup. Caramelized sugar, dark cocoa, blackberry leaf tea, tart berry, all spice. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Chirripo Joicafe
coffees.description: Has the kind of simple, clean bittersweetness in the cup that Costa Rican coffee is known for. Balanced sweetness and acidity, punchy bittersweetness that can be dialed up with roast development. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Don Mayo La Loma
coffees.description: Medium roasts strike a nice balance between bittersweetness and a well-integrated acidity, with hints of brown sugar, baked goods, walnut, semi-sweet chocolate, tannic finish. City+ to Full City.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Don Oscar Aguacates
coffees.description: Restrained complexity in the cup, the sweetness marked by subtle caramelized aspects, and bright hints. Notes of hazelnut, brown sugar, roasted barley green tea, dark cocoa, and dried green apple. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Dry Process Hacienda Sonora
coffees.description: Intense fruit flavors and winey accents should appeal to fans of anaerobic coffees, with impressive sweetness too! Peach brandy, raspberry balsamic, pomegranate molasses, chocolate liqueur, tannic tea. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Dry Process Hacienda Sonora
coffees.description: The kind of high intensity, fruit flavors fans of anaerobic coffees will love! Mulled wine, raspberry balsamic, tangy limoncello, pomegranate molasses, brooding bittersweetness, and rum-like aroma. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Honey Chirripo Bambú
coffees.description: Bittering tones have a brooding intensity when roasted dark, whereas light roasts bring out subtle fruited hints, spiced accents, and pungent baking cocoa finish. City to Full City. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Honey Don Oscar Typica Mejorado
coffees.description: This unique variety is brightly accented and prominently sweet, with delicate aromatic hints and exceptional cup clarity. Rapadura, burnt sugar, lemon tea, tart apricot, and a faint fruit-floral note. City to City+. *4 lb. limit per order

coffees.title: Costa Rica Honey Process Hacienda Sonora
coffees.description: Pungent bittersweetness connects to interesting accents of fruits and light herbal notes. Canned plums, unsulfured apricot, dark fruits with a winey ripeness, long bittering notes, pronounced body. City+ to Full City+.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Honey Process Hacienda Sonora
coffees.description: Flavors are harmoniously balanced, with good cup clarity, sweet notes of raw sugars and honey, accented by lively hints of citrus and tea that bring out pleasantly integrated acidic impression. City to Full City. *4# limit per customer due to the small quantity of this lot.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Lourdes Sumava Milenio Variety
coffees.subregion: Lourdes de Naranjo, Alajuela, West Valley
coffees.description: Sweet and bright at light roast levels, honey and unrefined sugar notes build a nice base flavor for brighter accents to pop out against, grapefruit, sour lemon, mild bittersweetness, clean to the finish. City to City+.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Monte Brisas Typica
coffees.description: Well rounded profile, layered sweetness, sparkling acidity, subtle aroma of fruit and tea. Flavors shape-shift as you move through the cup, butterscotch, cane juice, lemon sage, chamomile tea, sweet finish. City to City+.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Red Honey El Coyote
coffees.description: Light roasts brew a substantially sweet cup, brightly accented by tea-like top notes, and subtle suggestions of fruit. Honey, brown sugar, hibiscus flower tea, faint dried apple and tart berry, sweet finish. City to City+.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Tarrazu Beneficio Don Mayo
coffees.description: Middle roasts tease out sweet notes of creamy caramel, brown sugar and rice syrup, accented by hints of walnut, and apple, with an undercurrent of dark chocolate bittersweets. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Tarrazu Beneficio Los Angeles
coffees.description: The cup intensity comes off a bit like honey process coffee, moderately fruited, round body and rustic-sweetness underneath. Notes of dark corn syrup, dried peach, fig bar, apricot tea, raw nut and carob. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Tarrazu Casa de Piedra
coffees.description: Thick body is underpinned by sweetness, with subtle accents of fruit, and savory nut tones. Caramel, cocoa wheat berry, almond, honey on toast, and a mild acidic impression. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Tarrazu La Casona
coffees.description: Brightly sweet Costa Rica profile, mouth cleansing flavors, molasses, honey graham, barley tea, apple-like acidity, lighter body, nuanced finishing notes of lemon rind and tannic tea. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Tarrazu La Obediencia
coffees.description: Clean sweetness underscores the cup, syrupy like butterscotch and caramel sauce, accented by roast-toned chocolates, silky body, and apple-like acidity. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Tarrazú Cerro La Cruz
coffees.description: Exceedingly sweet Costa Rican coffee that makes a great "daily driver" as brewed coffee and espresso. Caramel, honey-glazed nuts, sweet tea, torched sugar, malted grains, Dutch drinking chocolate. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Tarrazú El Ruby
coffees.description: Exceedingly sweet Costa Rican coffee that will serve you well as an everyday drinker. Notes of honey cake, brown sugar cookie, cinnamon buns, brisk tea note, and Dutch cocoa. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Yellow Honey Helsar de Zarcero
coffees.description: Balanced sweetness, silky body and moderate bright accents. Syrupy texture is punctuated by a flavor of chocolate sauce, with accents of toasted coconut, almond, apple and a spiced finish. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Yellow Honey Sumava SL-28
coffees.subregion: Lourdes de Naranjo, Alajuela, West Valley
coffees.description: Acidity and syrupy sweetness stood out in the cup, which shouldn't be a surprise given the Kenyan variety. Aromatic honey note, cane juice, dark tea, Turkish spice mix, lemon-like brightness. City to City+.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Zarcero Danto Centroamericano
coffees.description: Full body carries creamy sweet notes, chocolate-toned bass flavors, hints of crisped caramel, dark chocolate-covered almond, and semi-sweet chocolate chips. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Zarcero Monte Brisas Cassiopea
coffees.description: Compact sweetness, dense body, top notes of dark caramel, burnt sugar with sharp intensity, acidic highlights when roasted light, lingering bittersweetness at darker levels. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Zarcero Monte Brisas Danto
coffees.description: Balanced bittersweetness, hints of burnt caramel, citrus zest, dried raisin, marzipan, chocolate-toned bass flavors when roasted dark, full body, baking chocolate in the finish. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Costa Rica Zarcero Monte Brisas Danto
coffees.description: Approachable coffee with a little something extra in the light roasts, and well suited for dark roasts too. Honeyed sweetness, red apple, brisk tea, spiced chocolate, aromatic finish. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: El Salvador Atiquizaya Tabi
coffees.description: Dark-toned bittersweetness that's crowd-pleasing, hints of unrefined sugar, cinnamon toast, an aftertaste that goes from caramel-nut to cocoa powder bittering in the long finish. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: El Salvador Dry Process Anacafé
coffees.description: High intensity coffee, thick-bodied, with flavor characteristics of rustic cocoa, fermented fruits, and earth-toned aroma. Notes of aromatic wood, poached pear, cider vinegar, raw cacao. City+ to Full City.

coffees.title: El Salvador Dry Process Cuscatleco
coffees.description: Pungent dark-toned bittering with a range of rustic fruits, and enticing cup aroma. Palm sugar, dried prune, cacao nibs, honey mead, cinnamon bark, cherry wood. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: El Salvador Dry Process Cuscatleco
coffees.description: Wild and wooly fruit flavors backed with pungent roast intensity. Winey fruits, stewed plum, hard cider, bittering dark cocoa, chocolate liqueur, and deep-toned finish. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: El Salvador Dry Process Finca Miravalles
coffees.description: Impressive roast intensity, thick body, with pulpy fruit accents and mild acidity. Hints of fig, blackberry wine, pomegranate dark chocolate, bittersweet torte, and smoked chocolate finish. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: El Salvador Dry Process Icatu
coffees.description: Pungent dry process with intense bittersweet flavors, countered by rustic fruits and a winey aroma. Notes of fruit leather, preserved orange, toasted sesame, burnt caramel, Sherry, Oaxacan chocolate. City+ to Full City+.

coffees.title: El Salvador Dry Process Miravalles Pacamara
coffees.description: A more fruit-forward, bittersweet profile than the washed Pacamara we sold earlier this year. Intense roast tones, burnt sugar, layered dark cocoa, rustic dried fruits and winey accents, lemon sage aroma, lime zest. City to Full City.

coffees.title: El Salvador Finca Miravalles Bourbon
coffees.description: Middle roasts develop bittersweet notes that punch through in the cup, along with sweet, and nutty characteristics. Cocoa, burnt sugar, walnut and roasted almond. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: El Salvador Finca Miravalles Castillo
coffees.description: Mid-toned cup flavors, mild acidity, malty-sweet notes of molasses bread with walnuts, accents of cereal grains, caramel, chocolate confections, and herbal aroma. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: El Salvador Finca San Miguel Bourbon
coffees.description: Roast versatility and balanced flavors, caramel-toned and creamy, notes of Dulce de Leche, hazelnut chocolate, vanilla bean, chocolate-covered almond, and dark cocoa. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: El Salvador Honey San Luis Bourbon
coffees.description: Rustic honey process coffee with deep-toned bittersweetness that gives way to pulpy fruit aspects and acetic hints, unrefined sugar, earthy cacao, and thick, buoyant mouthfeel. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: El Salvador Miravalles Pacamara
coffees.description: A nice counterpoint to some of the more low-toned Salvadoran coffees, with nuanced top notes, and moderate level of acidity. Caramel, hints of lime, green herb, chocolate caramel, and plum. City to Full City. *2# limit per customer.

coffees.title: El Salvador Miravalles Sampacho
coffees.description: Dark toned and bittersweet coffee, cocoa and nut flavors are crowd pleasing, low acidity makes it an attractive option for milk drinks and espresso too. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: El Salvador Miravalles Yellow Bourbon
coffees.description: Creamy caramel tones, traces of almond, malty accents, and mild acidity. Dark roasts punch up bittersweet flavors like high % cacao chocolate bar, baking cocoa, and more. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Agaro Kenisa
coffees.description: Strong showing of sweetness and body, with subtle fruits, and rustic aroma. Made a stunning Ethiopian espresso that brought complex bittersweetness without overwhelming the palate. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Anaerobic Natural Gerba Dogo
coffees.subregion: Gerba Dogo, Bule Hora, Guji Zone
coffees.description: Ripe fruits are balanced by supportive sweetness and delicate aromatic highlights. Complex profile of berry compote, peach jam, fresh hops, rue, winey accents of oaky rum and fruit liqueur chocolates. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Bensa Kokose
coffees.description: Great brewed and as espresso, strikes a balance between layers of berry and chocolate, notes of cherry cordial, drinking chocolate, dried blueberry, raspberry truffle, a lot to grab onto in the cup! City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Benti Nenka
coffees.description: Expansive profile that could almost pass for a wet process coffee if not for the hefty dried fruit flavors. Natural dried peach, apricot, hints of blueberry, fig, fragrant spice, orange glaze, and tea-like finish. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Birbirsa
coffees.description: Brightly-accented dry process coffee, with stone fruit and honey notes that are unique to coffees from the West. Red honey, pear, peach, Earl Grey tea, cocoa bittersweets (especially in dark roasts). City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Bobea Uke
coffees.description: Straddles the line between fruit-forward flavors and delicate aromatics, excellent both light and medium roasted. Berry-toned sweetness, passion fruit, dried peach, tea bittering, whole spices, chocolate-covered fruit. City to Full City. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Buno Dambi Uddo
coffees.description: Flavorful fruit and berry notes, fragrant aromatic hints, and a bittersweet layer that's easily developed with roast. Blueberry, natural dried fruits, marmalade, twist of citrus, black forest cake. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Chelchele Shitaye Abebe
coffees.description: Fruit-toned at a variety of roast levels, from juicy berry accents, to deep bittersweetness with dried fruit accents. Notes of plum, dried pineapple, raspberry tea, citrus, dried apricot, bittering spice. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Dogo Sodu
coffees.description: The fruit salad of flavors and fragrant aromatic top notes push this natural to the next level. Notes of red berries, dried peach, mango, papaya, tenadam herb, jasmine pearl tea, and complex aftertaste. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Duromina Aba Bulgu
coffees.description: Nice range of rustic fruit to bittersweet flavors, with acidity that's easy to tame. Sorghum, dried blueberry, resiny incense, bittersweet chocolate, excellent Ethiopia for dark roasts. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Guji Buku
coffees.subregion: Buku Sayisa, Hambela Wamena, Guji Zone
coffees.description: This intensely fruited Guji extracts plump fruit and berry flavors, with strong spiced aromatic notes that bring out herbal/floral flair. Notes of blueberry, cooked peach, mixed melon salad, and fragrant rue. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Guji Goro
coffees.description: Pairs dry process flavors of expressive fruits and rustic sweetness with the kind of bright acidity and aromatic highlights of a washed coffee . Boysenberry, dried apricot, potpourri, citrus, chocolate-covered fruit. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Guji Goro
coffees.description: Intense dry process character of potent fruits, rustic accents, and complex aromatics that cover a lot of ground. Strawberry, dried stone fruits, sorghum, rue herb, cedar shakes, dark cocoa. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Guji Tuku
coffees.subregion: Gerba Dogo, Bule Hora, Guji Zone
coffees.description: Impressive interplay of potent aromatics and snappy fruits, with fragrant profiles of rose and jasmine pearl teas, lemongrass, rue herb, tart raspberry, orange and pomegranate molasses. City to City+.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Guji Tuku
coffees.subregion: Gerba Dogo, Bule Hora, Guji Zone
coffees.description: Impressive interplay of complex fruits and delicate aromatics, floral and bright like a washed coffee, with complex profiles of blueberry, pomegranate molasses, honeydew melon, and coriander. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Guji Uraga
coffees.description: One of our more versatile dry process Ethiopian coffees, from juicy fruits, spiced sweetness, and convincing acidity, to chocolate-driven profiles, orange highlights, and chicory tea. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Hambela Buliye
coffees.subregion: Kebele Dari Bishan Fugu, Guji Zone
coffees.description: Exceptional dry process coffee that expresses a complex range of sticky dried fruit flavors, syrupy sweetness, and bright hints. Dried apricot and blueberry, caramelized sugars, sweet finish. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Hambela Goro
coffees.subregion: Kebele Goro Badessa, Woreda Hambela Wamena
coffees.description: Intense dry process characteristics, fruited to bittersweet, thick body, aromatic accents, with tart hints that draw out acidity. Mixed berry jam, dried peach, chocolate goji berry, Chai spice, dark chocolate. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Kercha Haruse
coffees.description: On the "light and bright" end of the spectrum for dry process coffees, clean fresh fruits, citron essence, yuzu, and mandarin, lightly floral, fragrant black tea. Makes an excellent pour-over brew. City to City+.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Kercha Hebo
coffees.description: This natural excels in middle-to-dark roasts, where dark berry and cocoa flavors take center stage, dried blueberry, rustic fruit compote, dark chocolate, silky body, aromatic rue and earth tones. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Korate
coffees.description: Korate shows very nice fruit tones in the cup, with shifting flavor profiles as it cools. Bittersweet tones underpin the cup, with dried peach, berry, mint, baking spices, red tea, pungent burnt sugar, dark chocolate truffle. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Senna Katta Mountain
coffees.description: Impressive Limu natural that's quite versatile. Attractive sweetness plays off modest fruit and berry tones, with an aromatic finish. Body and bittersweet potential make it an ideal Ethiopia for espresso too. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Suke Quto
coffees.description: Quite a powerhouse dry process, intensely fruited and aromatic, with a bit of low-end heft that builds balancing bittersweet tones. Notes include dried tropical fruits, musk melon, rue herb, chocolate-covered berries. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Uraga Yabitu Koba
coffees.subregion: Kebele Yabitu Koba, Woreda Uraga, Guji Zone
coffees.description: The cup has many features of both wet and dry process coffees, dynamic fruit flavors, clean sweetness, hefty body, grabby citrus aspect in the top end, floral hint, and dried Turkish apricot. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Dry Process Yirga Cheffe Halo Beriti
coffees.description: Impressive core sweetness and roast tones balance the scales of an otherwise fruited, bright dry process. Dark caramelized sugars, well-defined citrus, chocolate, and mango. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Duromina Aba Bulgu
coffees.description: Syrupy honey sweetness is brightly accented by aromatic fruits and vibrant citrus notes. Accents of juicy stone fruits, ripe strawberry, mango, lemon Italian ice, hibiscus tea. Works well at a range of roast levels. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Gerba Hechere
coffees.description: This wet process coffee makes a fantastic pour-over at City roast level, fragrant florals, delicate tea-like flavors, high toned accents, hints of fruit, and syrupy sweetness that carried the cup. City to City+. Dark roasts make nice Ethiopian espresso.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Godina Guji SWP Decaf
coffees.description: Light roasts harness origin flavors like peach and nectarine, persimmon filling, spiced aromatics of clove, cinnamon, nutmeg, and chai, with brown sugar sweetness, and accents of rye crisps. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Guji Gerba Dogo
coffees.subregion: Dogo Sodu Kebele, Gerba, Guji Zone
coffees.description: A juicy coffee in terms of fruit flavors and acidity, with perfumed aromatics that bring a delicate dimension to the cup. Berry-toned, bright citrus, bittering spices, fragrant green herbs, and jasmine flower. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Guji Goro Bedessa
coffees.description: A beautiful Guji coffee, delicate top end contrasted by bodied/bittering elements that keep it from feeling "lightweight" overall. Lovely floral notes, jasmine pearl tea, blackberry juice, peach, lemon, and hop water. City to City+.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Guji Hambela Dabaye
coffees.description: Delicious and delicate light roasted, refined sweetness, tart acidity, and fragrant accents. Notes of honey, simple syrup, maple, pear, orange marmalade, and floral hints that permeate the aroma. City to City+.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Guji Hambela Dabaye
coffees.description: Delicious and delicate light roasted, juicy sweetness, tart acidity, and fragrant aromatics. Notes of white honey, nectarine, apricot, and a passion fruit floral note permeates the aroma. City to City+.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Gure Dako
coffees.description: We're enjoying medium roasts of Gure Dako, substantial bittersweetness accented by notes of stone fruit, molasses, lime zest, and spiced fruit hints that penetrate the aroma. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Hambela Benti Nenka
coffees.description: Syrupy sweet coffee with fruit accents that peak in light roasts. Peach, honey, warming spices, tart twist of green grape, tea-like acidity, and an aromatic rue note bring a freshness to the cup. City to City+

coffees.title: Ethiopia Honey Process Guji Goro
coffees.description: Very clean honey coffee, delicious fruit profiles, fragrant aroma, refined acidity, and opaque dense mouthfeel. Cools to hints of red honey, pineapple, melon, marmalade, and lavender. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Honey Process Haro Wachu
coffees.description: Deeply sweet honey process Ethiopia, substantial mouthfeel contrasted by bright accents, and enticing aromatics. Notes of piloncillo raw sugar, creamy honey, lemon, floral hint, fenugreek seed, Oolong tea. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Kayon Mountain Taaroo
coffees.description: Distinct aromatic Guji character, fresh rue herb, perfumed florals of star jasmine and gardenia blossom, juicy flame grape, tart high tones, sweet spices, syrupy mouthfeel, creamy coconut oil finish. City to City+.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Kercha Bilida Bukisa
coffees.description: Works well at a range of roasts, modestly fruited, weighty sweetness, peach cobbler, brown sugar, orange marmalade, red apple, chocolate mango, and moderate acidic impression. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Organic Agaro Kenisa
coffees.description: Caramelized sugars and honey sweetness fade to hints of slab apricot, piquant orange acidity, subtle notes of whole spices and dried flowers. See roasting tips in the cup notes. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Organic Dry Process Birbirsa
coffees.description: Impressive natural from Western Jimma, moderate intensity, cleanly fruited notes of berry jam, dried mango, orange marmalade, and very nice roast bittering underneath. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Organic Gera Nano Challa
coffees.description: This wet process Ethiopia has dark honey sweetness with stone fruit flavors, like peach and apricot, accented by notes of black tea, orange citrus, light floral hint, and outstanding fruited acidity. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Uraga Gogogu
coffees.subregion: Wate Gogogu, Uraga Woreda, Guji Zone
coffees.description: Such an expressive coffee that shows excellent cup clarity and fragrant aromatic highlights. Syrupy-sweet cane juice, ginger snap cookie, freesia flowers, hops fruit tea infusions, kiwi and mango. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Uraga Gogogu
coffees.subregion: Wate Gogogu, Uraga Woreda, Guji Zone
coffees.description: Cup sweetness is fruited and bright, with perfumed floral aromatic highlights that linger in the finish. Notes of simple syrup, dried mango, lemon tea, jasmine, fresh basil, Chinese pear, tart hibiscus. Top washed Ethiopia! City to City+.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Uraga Raro Boda
coffees.description: Light and bright coffee, tea-like and aromatic. It pulls out delicate sweetness and mouth cleansing acidity, with notes Earl Grey, jasmine, lemongrass, basil, simple syrup, honey and limeade. City to City+.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Uraga Raro Boda
coffees.description: City roasts of this wet process coffee hit the target for aromatic floral notes, and doesn't compromise sweetness! Pour over brews showed star jasmine, simple syrup, Earl Grey tea, limeade, and a honeyed finish. City to City+.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Uraga SWP Decaf
coffees.description: Lively decaf coffee, sweetness that's fairly refined, like simple syrup made with brown sugar. Notes of honey, lemon black tea, chocolate malted grain, cherry cordial, and lemongrass in the nose. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Uraga Siko
coffees.description: For fans of floral coffee. Attractive jasmine and rose notes, vibrant berry-toned accents, fragrant honey sweetness, hints of lime, rose, pink bubblegum, and spiced Darjeeling tea. Shines as a pour-over brew. City to Full City. Dark roasts work for espresso.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Yirga Cheffe Banko Gotiti
coffees.description: This wet process Ethiopia produces Gesha-like floral aromatics, with transparent sweetness and tropical candy fruit accents. Such an elegant pour over, notes of agave, mango, guava, jasmine, and lemonade. City to City+.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Yirga Cheffe Wote Konga
coffees.description: Sweet undercurrent, mouth-cleansing acidity at the lighter end of the roast spectrum, honey, baked sugar, hints of peach, orange marmalade, gum drop candies, lightly floral aroma, and citrus. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Fermentation Project Green Coffee Set
coffees.description: The Fermentation Project Green Coffee Set contains four different versions of the same coffee processed with different fermentation methods. These coffees are part of a collaborative project by James Hoffmann and Lucia Solis, culminating in a global tasting event on October 3rd. You’ll receive one ½ lb bag of each method: mechanically demucilaged ("machine washed"), wild fermentation, lactobacillus inoculated…

coffees.title: Flores Anaerobic Dry Process Turelelo
coffees.description: The coffee cherries for this dry process lot underwent 72 hour anaerobic fermentation, resulting in an intense profile that's fruit forward and rustic, with complex fermented highlights, and dusky roast tones. City to Full CIty+.

coffees.title: Flores Anaerobic Honey Process Turelelo
coffees.description: This is not a fruity anaerobic, but surprisingly chocolate-forward and creamy, bittersweet flavors of smoked chocolate, flourless torte, roasted nibs, and chocolate dipped banana. City+ to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Flores Bajawa Eko Heto
coffees.description: Thick in terms of body and rich chocolate tones, heavy on the palate, and bittersweetness shadows the cup flavors and mild top notes through a long lasting finish. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Flores Bajawa Om David
coffees.description: Bittersweet roast intensity, steeped cacao, burnt sugar, baking chocolate bittering finish. Hint of green herb, and accent of black tea brings a bit of acidity to the cup. Pairs well with cream. City+ to Full City+.

coffees.title: Flores Wolo Wio
coffees.description: Very versatile coffee with round body, and nice intensity overall. Hints of black tea, citrus rind, complex lemongrass brightness, and bittersweetness that resonates in the finish. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Flores Wolo Wio
coffees.description: Weighty mouthfeel, a nice intensity overall, well balanced, with ample bittersweetness rounding out the cup. Caramel, date sugar, Snickerdoodle, round body, cocoa. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Green Coffee Subscription
coffees.description: Take the hassle out of choosing green coffee, and keep up your stash with a selection of our outstanding, carefully selected green coffee. You are able to choose the frequency and amount you receive, and it's easy to change or cancel at any time! The coffees we send are from our extensive inventory of green coffee here at Sweet Maria's. At times they might be coffees exclusive to the sampler set, and not available…

coffees.title: Guatemala Acatenango Gesha
coffees.description: A lightly floral cup with refined sweetness, top notes of fruit and spice, hints of raw cane sugar, simple syrup, honey, jasmine pearl tea, apple, pear, tartaric acidity, whole cardamom and Allspice. City to City+.

coffees.title: Guatemala Acatenango Gesha AA
coffees.description: Light roasts highlight the delicate floral aroma that's made the Gesha variety so famous. Persistent cup sweetness, simple syrup, pear, persimmon, violet, jasmine pearls, Meyer lemon, and tannic tea notes. City to City+.

coffees.title: Guatemala Anaerobic Aguacatones
coffees.description: Fruited anaerobic with a pungent bittersweet side that helps draw out interesting flavor notes of sticky dried fruits, berries, and winey accents, and thick body leads to a long finish. City to Full City. Good for espresso. *Only 300 lbs available, limit 2 lbs per customer.

coffees.title: Guatemala Antigua Carmona Pulcal
coffees.description: Well-rounded cup profile, balanced core flavors of dark sugars and bittersweet chocolate, hint of fruit that impacts acidity. Full City shows brooding cocoa-roast tones and dark fruit accents. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Antigua Finca Cabrejo
coffees.description: Boasts impressive cup clarity and roast versatility. Brightly accented sweetness is traded for more dominant bittersweets at darker levels. Raw sugar, lemon tea, vanilla, cocoa, bittering spice finish. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Antigua Finca San Miguel Urias
coffees.description: Flavors are familiar and simple, well-balanced and easy to drink. Malty-sweetness, burnt sugar, almond, milk chocolate and mild hint of acidity. It's the kind of coffee I find myself reaching for. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Antigua Hunapu Ciudad Vieja
coffees.description: Well-balanced, bittersweet brew, hints of caramel glaze, hazelnut-chocolate spread, and malted beer grains. Moderate acidity points to zested citrus and roasted barley tea. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Antigua Hunapu Ciudad Vieja
coffees.description: Balanced bittersweet base flavors, brown sugar, semi-sweet chocolate, cinnamon cocoa, candied nut, hint of apple. Perfect "dual purpose" coffee for brewing and single origin espresso. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Antigua Java
coffees.description: Soft top-end accents of black tea and lemon balm are found amidst dominant, yet balanced raw sugar sweetness, with hints of red apple, malted grains and mild bittersweetness. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Guatemala Antigua Java Variety
coffees.description: The cup has lasting sweetness and impressive clarity. Body is light and crisp, with a dynamic acidic impression that's most pointed in light roasts. Top notes hint at brown sugar, black tea, green apple, lemongrass. City to City+.

coffees.title: Guatemala Antigua La Folie
coffees.description: Good cup clarity, bracing highlights and a sweet, refined finish. Notes of cane sugar, marzipan, tangerine, rose hips, with cocoa undertones that can be developed with roast. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Guatemala Antigua La Folie
coffees.description: A bit more "umph" than your average Central American coffee. Mildly sweet, bracing acidity, with attractive spiced fruit accents, and bittersweet finish. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Antigua Pavón Farm
coffees.description: Nice example of Antiguan Bourbon coffee, crowd-pleasing balance at a wide roast range, modest acidity, hints of brown sugar, hazelnut, apple, dark chocolate desserts, and ample body. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Antigua Pulcal Inteligente
coffees.description: Delightful brewed coffee that's deeply sweet, with delicate top notes, and elegant acidity. Notes of toasted sugars, black tea, and lemon. Full City are low-toned and bittersweet, with a hint of dark fruit. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Atitlan Robusta
coffees.description: Pungent bittering and a potent savory dimension, with thick body and low acidity. Notes of cacao nibs, baking chocolate, burnt popcorn, toasted barley, cumin, long bittering finish. Full City to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Chimaltenango Tecpan
coffees.description: Bittersweet across a wide roast range, nut and caramel accents, cocoa-dusted almond, chocolate-covered pistachio, with notes of cocoa butter and sesame in the finish. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Chimaltenango Tecpán
coffees.description: Nutty-sweet impressions and bittersweet at a wide range of roasts. Notes of cocoa-dusted almond, toffee nut, chocolate-covered pistachio, cocoa butter and sesame halva. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Chocal Keneth Merida Pacamara
coffees.description: This unique Pacamara variety brews impressive bittersweets at a range of roasts, accented by notes of purple fruits, flame grape, black plum, and fig, with juicy acidity, and dark chocolate finish. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Guatemala Coban Chichupak Coop
coffees.description: "Classic" Guatemalan cup in a lot of ways; sweet and simple, big bodied, and low-toned bittersweets. Hints of turbinado sugar, baked apple, cinnamon stick, chocolate-dipped almond. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Dry Process Aguacatones
coffees.description: Intense low tones temper dark fruit flavors in the middle/dark roasts. Base flavor of extra dark chocolate, hints of rustic dried fruit, raw cacao, brown ale, thick body lends to long finish. City+ to Full City+. Excellent espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Dry Process Finca Rosma
coffees.description: Wild and wooly fruit flavors that are winey and sweet, plump body, substantial bittersweetness, hints of blackberry wine, rustic dried fruit, musky papaya, chocolate cherry, hints of fruit liqueurs. City to Full City. *Available in 1 lb and 2 lb bags, with a 4 lb limit per customer

coffees.title: Guatemala El Socorro Java Variety
coffees.description: Delicate flavors, transparent sweetness and aromatic top notes are elegant and refined. Great "Java" character, tea-like, lemon, coriander, rose hips, with bracing acidity that suits the light bodied cup. City to City+.

coffees.title: Guatemala El Socorro Java Variety
coffees.description: Clean, transparent sweetness in the cup, with aromatic top notes that bring a sense of elegance and refinement to the flavors. Great "Java" character, tea-like, lightly floral, bracing citrus hints. City to City+.

coffees.title: Guatemala FTO Dry Process Chuacús
coffees.description: Intense flavor profiles of rustic fruits, pungent burnt sugars, and a long, persistent finish. Bittersweet undercurrent contrasts notes of ripe banana, chocolate liqueur, and roasted chicory root. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Guatemala FTO Honey Process Chuacús
coffees.description: Intense bittersweetness gives way to rustic dried fruits, raisin, plantain and papaya, a sprinkling of spice, baking chocolate, thick body, and a long, lingering aftertaste. City+ to Full City+.

coffees.title: Guatemala FTO Huehuetenango WP Decaf
coffees.description: Balanced flavors, lightly sweet and malty, capable of deep-toned profiles in dark roasts. Notes of sorghum syrup, malted milk powder, raw almond, baking spice, tea bittering, cocoa. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Honey Process Aguacatones
coffees.description: Focused around brightly accented sweetness, creamy undertones with a lively top end, dark honey, brisk black tea with lemon, citrus peel, cinnamon stick, hints of dried date and strawberry. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Guatemala Huehuetenango Don Mauricio
coffees.description: Attractive sweetness laced with hints of caramel and dark sugars, along with fruited accents that add to malic-type acidic impression. Apple, roast bittersweetness, mulling spice, and traces of almond. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Guatemala Huehuetenango Finca La Bolsa
coffees.description: Well balanced bittersweet tones, semi-sweet chocolate chips, nutty aroma, hints of almond cake and Baklava, quietly present acidity. Excellent coffee for milk drinks. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Huehuetenango Lote Hamacas
coffees.description: Balanced sweetness stood out in all our roasts, with City+ being a great place to start. Layered sweetness, dulce de leche, caramelized sugars, flan, mild citrus brightness, dense body. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Huehuetenango Silvestre Velasquez
coffees.description: Sweet highlights through the finish, fruited hints draw out a moderate level of acidity when roasted light, notes of brown sugar, molasses, raisin, berry, milk chocolate, and vanilla caramel. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Guatemala Huehuetenango Silvestre Velasquez
coffees.description: Sweet highlights through the finish, and fruited characteristics that draw out tart acidity when roasted light. Panela, brûlée sugar, fermented orange, hint of hibiscus tea, apple, and vanilla caramel. City to City+.

coffees.title: Guatemala Huehuetenango Terrazas Don Pilo
coffees.description: Restrained top notes work their way up from behind more prominent sweet and roast toned flavors, with hints of caramel almond, snickerdoodle, semi sweet chocolate, walnut. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Huehuetenango Unión Cantinil
coffees.description: Crowd-pleasing flavors across a wide roast spectrum, bittersweet and balanced, notes of sweet baked goods, chocolate crinkle cookie, caramel-almond, dark-toned cocoa, walnut, a glint of acidity. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala La Libertad Rancho Viejo
coffees.description: Sweetness draws on raw sugar, malted chocolate, creamy nut, with moderate acidity that ties it all together. Hints of macadamia, panela, chocolate covered nut. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Libertad Aurelio Del Cerro
coffees.description: Balanced sweetness and pleasant roast tones are accented by hints of brown sugar, cinnamon, red apple, berry tea, chocolate torte, and more. A very versatile coffee. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Libertad Aurelio del Cerro
coffees.description: Balanced sweetness and nice roast intensity, notes of rustic sugars, bittersweet undertones, hints of cinnamon, dried fig and date, and substantial mouthfeel at all roast levels. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Libertad Aurelio del Cerro
coffees.description: Versatile coffee that pairs balanced sweetness and very nice roast intensity, with hints of cinnamon, red apple, juicy acidity, bittersweet cocoa, and substantial mouthfeel. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Michicoy Finca Rosma
coffees.description: Bittersweet undercurrent of raw sugar and chocolate, hints of dried apple, grape, coconut, aromatic spice hints, moderate acidic impression, and balanced aftertaste. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Michicoy Finca Rosma Lot 1
coffees.description: Light roasts brew a sweet undercurrent of raw sugar and light caramel, with hints of dried apple, blackberry leaf tea, cinnamon and malic brightness. Deeper roasts develop bittersweet chocolate tones and raisin. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Patzun Finca La Florida
coffees.description: Bittersweet core flavors are accented by light citrus hints, lemon bar, marzipan, baking spice. Roast tones take on a chocolaty dimension, especially at medium and dark levels. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Patzún Finca Santa Anita
coffees.description: Convincing sweetness at a wide range of roasts, with fruited flavors that gain momentum as the coffee cools. Caramel, spiced apple cider, stewed pears, and syrupy mouthfeel. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala San Diego Buena Vista Bourbon
coffees.description: Attractive bittersweet flavor profile, delicious dark chocolate aspects, cocoa powder, vanilla caramel, Brazil nut, molasses, tenor toned hints. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala San Diego Buena Vista Pink Bourbon
coffees.description: City+ is a good starting point, where layered sweet flavors are focused, and a pleasant acidic note brightens the cup. Butter caramel, coconut date roll, Matcha, and dark cocoa. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala San Martin Jilotepeque
coffees.description: Versatile coffee, with crowd pleasing at almost any roast level. Sturdy cup flavors, rounded sweetness, balanced low tones, hints of cocoa, nut, torched sugar, and dried fruit. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Turbala Finca Alonzo
coffees.description: Carried by honeyed sweetness, with unique fruit accents that crown the cup. Light roasts offer glimpses of tart fruits and a crisp finish, while Full City develops bittersweet chocolate accented by dark fruit. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Guatemala Xinabajul Aler Villatoro
coffees.description: Ample bittersweets with fruited aspects that play up acidity a bit resulting in a balanced, but lively profile. Honey sweetness, dark sugars, fruit tea, dried apple, and dark cocoa. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Xinabajul Antonio Castillo
coffees.description: Layered sweetness, light brown sugar, caramel, and butterscotch, with hints of pear and orange that brought out acidity. Opaque chocolate roast tones and burnt sugar when roasted dark. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Xinabajul Axel Palacios
coffees.description: Delicious confluence of dark sugars and dried fruit hints, with fruited acidity that has a pleasantly grabby aspect. Notes of brown sugar, dried fig and date, orange tea, dark chocolate truffles. City to Full City+. Good for espresso

coffees.title: Guatemala Xinabajul Axel Palacios
coffees.description: Brews fantastic in the City/City+ range, syrupy sweet flavors shift from raw sugars to plump fruits, with very nice perceived acidity, a bit grabby in the mouthfeel, and rounded out by a sweet finish. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Guatemala Xinabajul Bojonalito
coffees.description: Such a pleasant coffee to drink, balanced core bittersweets, great chocolate roast tonality, creamy body, accents of caramel, cinnamon, and almond. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Xinabajul Flory Villatoro
coffees.description: In that "daily driver" category of coffees, well-balanced sweetness with just a touch of acidity that adds nuance. Brown sugar, butterscotch, cinnamon, chocolate truffle, ganache, apple-like acidity. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Guatemala Xinabajul Guilmer Castillo
coffees.description: Balanced flavors that get me reaching for a second cup. Interplay between caramel sweetness and smokey roast tones leads to profiles of dark chocolate-covered caramel, and walnut brownie. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Xinabajul Lisandro Hidalgo
coffees.description: Layered sweetness and roast tones, accents of butterscotch, caramel, and apple. Light roasts show modest acidity, whereas darker levels build chocolate laden profiles, and bittering finish. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Xinabajul Miriam Gomez
coffees.description: Crowd pleasing sweetness wrapped in bittersweet flavors and heavy body, with an acidic hint of malic fruits. Caramel, raw sugar, semi-sweet chocolate, and apple. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Xinabajul Peaberry
coffees.description: Built around sugar browning sweetness with very nice chocolate dimension backing things up. Creme brûlée crust, milk chocolate, semi-sweet chips, currant, and bittersweet finish. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Xinabajul Producers Lot 2
coffees.description: Perfect "dual-use" for brew and espresso. Balanced sweetness, notes of minimally processed sugars, blackberry, lemon, cocoa/chocolate roast tones, and a lasting bittersweet finish. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Xinabajul Rosalio Villatoro
coffees.description: Balanced bittersweetness at a wide range of roasts, with crowd-pleasing flavors of chocolate and nuts. Flavors of toffee, semi-sweet chocolate chips, chocolate biscotti, almond and walnut. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Xinabajul Rosalio Villatoro
coffees.description: Light-to-medium roasts develop balanced profiles of aromatic sweetness and chocolate roast tones, honey and raw sugar, chocolate-covered almond, well-integrated top notes, and fruited acidity. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Guatemala Xinabajul Rosalio Villatoro
coffees.description: Balanced sweetness, big body, raw sugar, creamy caramel, and apple-like acidity. Darker roasts bring out low-toned cocoa notes, bittersweet chips, and flourless chocolate torte. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Guatemala Xinabajul San Pedro Necta
coffees.description: Balanced cup flavors and moderate acidity, broad bittersweet tones, chocolate wafer cookie, dark drinking cocoa, caramel-sweet finish, hints of spice and tea in the aftertaste. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Hawaii Kona Darnall Estate Typica
coffees.description: Balanced sweetness opens up to soft bright tones as it cools, with top note hints that are elegant and clean. Raw sugar, brown malt, dried apple, rose hip tea, sweet citrus, and a pleasantly bittersweet finish. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Hawaii Kona Darnall Estate Typica
coffees.description: Balanced sweetness opens up to subtle bright tones, and top note hints that are elegant and clean. Raw sugar, brown malt, rose hip tea, herbal accents, and a pleasantly bittersweet finish. *4 lbs per customer.

coffees.title: Hawaii Kona XF Darnall Estate Typica
coffees.description: * Limit 2 lb per customer. Balanced sweetness opens up to subtle bright tones, and top note hints that are elegant and clean. Molasses, burnt sugar, brown malt, rose hips tea, citrus, cola, pleasantly sweet finish. City to City+.

coffees.title: Honduras Anibal Erazo Pacas
coffees.subregion: El Cedral, Las Vegas, Santa Barbara
coffees.description: We loved the bittersweet, caramelized flavors that show at middle roast levels. Lingering dark chocolate flavors are the centerpiece, syrupy body, almond, and a hint of dried fruit. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Honduras Dry Process Edwin Ever Parainema
coffees.description: Fruited sweetness goes from fermented berry cider to grape-toned, with complex earthy aroma of dandelion and ginseng teas, orange hint, cherry cordials, rustic cocoa dark chocolate-raspberry truffles. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Honduras Edwin Ever Sabillon Parainema
coffees.description: Notable sweetness and a splash of acidity when roasted on the lighter side. Raw sugar notes shift to a caramelized shade in the aftertaste, with glimpses of tart orange, dark tea, and hints of spice. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Honduras El Cedral Lourdes Figueroa
coffees.subregion: El Cedral, Las Vegas, Santa Barbara
coffees.description: Balanced roast tones and creamy mouthfeel at medium roast levels, with hints of spice in the top end. Notes of caramel, cinnamon powder, dark cocoa, smoked chocolate. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Honduras El Cedral Roberto Figueroa
coffees.subregion: El Cedral, Las Vegas, Santa Barbara
coffees.description: Straightforward profile, weaving caramel and toffee sweetness with clean finishing hints of vanilla almond tea, and cocoa. Deeper roasts are bittersweet, with dark chocolate caramel. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Honduras El Sauce Alejandro Guzman
coffees.description: Middle roasts pull together a mix of dense, dark roast tones, soft acidity, and savory accents. Notes of burnt sugar, high % dark chocolate, toffee peanut, sea salt chocolate brownie. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Honduras FTO Marcala WP Decaf
coffees.description: This Honduras lot flies under the radar as being decaf coffee, especially in light roasts where clean sweetness and sparkling acidity really shine! Notes of raw sugar, tangerine, Meyer lemon, and crisp, light body. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Honduras Honey Andres Fernandez Parainema
coffees.description: Tangy dried fruit notes, apricot and nectarine, syrupy canned pear, and tobacco hint in the finish. Full bittersweet tones when roasted dark, thick body, with fruited sweetness underneath. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Honduras Honey Process Sara Chinchilla
coffees.description: Skews toward the fruity end of the flavor spectrum, with bittersweetness playing a supporting role. Cherry, blackberry, wild berry kefir, dark cocoa, chocolate covered cranberry, chocolate-berry truffle. City+ to Full City+.

coffees.title: Honduras Las Flores Anibal Baca
coffees.description: Strikes a nice balance between mild sugary sweetness and roast toned bittering. Notes of brown sugar, caramel, hint of citrus, cinnamon stick, and dark cocoa aftertaste. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Honduras Maria Isabel Parainema
