coffees.description: Tannic brightness plays off underpinning of caramel, with a faint herbal hint of rosemary. Full City shows straight-ahead bittersweetness that pairs well with the creamy body, and works great with milk. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Honduras Maria Isabel Parainema
coffees.description: Impressive acidity plays off long lasting sweetness, brown sugars, aromatic accents, mouth refreshing lemongrass tea, hints of fruit and chamomile. Light roasts make a fantastic pour over. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Honduras San Jose Carlos Damian
coffees.subregion: San Jose de los Andes, Las Vegas, Santa Barbara
coffees.description: Very pleasant coffee to drink, well balanced acidity props up mid-toned flavors, light brown sugar, caramel, dried apple, milk chocolate, hint of raw pistachio. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Honduras San Jose Wil Armijo
coffees.subregion: San Jose de los Andes, Las Vegas, Santa Barbara
coffees.description: Well balanced sweetness in the brew, and the soft highlights and acidic hints presented in the light roasts were where I found my perfect brew. Caramel, tres leches, simple syrup, apple cinnamon tea. City to City+.

coffees.title: Honduras Teodosa Moreno Parainema
coffees.subregion: Los Andes, Las Vegas, Santa Barbara
coffees.description: Middle roasts brew up well rounded flavors that are caramel-sweet, creamy, and moderately bright. Profiles play off toffee and praline nut notes, herbal lemongrass tea, Dutch cocoa and woody spices. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Honduras Wilmer Dubon Pacas
coffees.subregion: El Cedral, Las Vegas, Santa Barbara
coffees.description: Pronounced sweetness is no doubt a contributing factor to the balanced flavors, brown sugar, toffee, pungent bittersweets, accents of dried currant, spice, and citrus rind. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: India Balmadi Estate Peaberry
coffees.description: Reminiscent of a bittersweet Central American coffees. Brown sugar and caramel, dark chocolate and baking cocoa, toasted barley, chocolate granola, and pecan. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: India Monsoon Malabar
coffees.description: An interesting cup for fans of earthy, pungent roast tones, and low acid coffees. Dark roasting recommended, brings body and deep low tones to espresso blends (we use it in Liquid Amber!). Read full cup notes. Full City+ to French.

coffees.title: India Monsoon Malabar AA
coffees.description: An interesting cup for fans of earthy, pungent roast tones, and low acid coffees. Dark roasting recommended, brings body and deep low tones to espresso blends (we use it in Liquid Amber!). Read full cup notes. Full City+ to French. Good for espresso blending.

coffees.title: India Muthodi Garige Khan Estate
coffees.description: Sweet and savory umami notes pair well. Flavor profiles of caramel-coated popcorn, sweetened brown rice tea, a pleasantly moderate level of acidity, and fades to a cocoa powder note in the long finish. City+ to Full City+.

coffees.title: India Pearl Mountain Estate Peaberry
coffees.description: Nice interplay of bittersweetness and nutty hints, with notes of light brown sugar, praline nut, dark cocoa, malted grains, syrupy mouthfeel, and burnt sugar finish. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: India Ratnagiri Estate AB
coffees.description: Very pleasant middle roasts, cocoa tones pair well with roasted almond, malt-like sweetness, dense body, and higher tonal range considering a relatively low acidic impression. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Indonesia Nusantara SWP Decaf
coffees.description: Very approachable bittersweetness, with identifiable hints of origin characteristics like brown rice syrup, palm sugar, herbal tarragon, and some very subtle fruits. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Java Sunda Anaerobic Honey Bukit Paniisan
coffees.description: "Anaerobic" characteristics are subtle, resulting in tenor-to-bass depth, without excess winey flavors. Fruit-toned, peach and pear, cocoa bittersweets, background notes of tobacco and spice, opaque body. City+ to Full City+.

coffees.title: Java Sunda Anaerobic Honey Puncak Sirna
coffees.subregion: Puncak Sirna, Rancabali, Bandung, West Java
coffees.description: Heavy body heightens bittersweet flavors, like high % cacao bar and baking chocolate, with a plum note behind it, and a vanilla/spice combination that plays into flavor profile of spiced rum. City+ to Full City+.

coffees.title: Java Sunda Cimara
coffees.description: Sweet base flavors saturate the cup profile, balancing roast tone and subtle top notes. Caramelized sugar, sweet tea, accents of hop flower, fresh spearmint, and Meyer lemon. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Java Sunda Honey Garut Robusta
coffees.description: Intense low tones with faint caramelized notes, unique earthy flavors, baking chocolate, hints of pumpkin seed, puffed wheat, tobacco, vanilla, Umami accents, low acidity. Full City to French. Good for espresso blends.

coffees.title: Java Sunda Mekarsari
coffees.description: Very nice interplay of bittersweetness and bracing bright notes that give this coffee a well-structured feel. Notes of dark chocolate, zested orange, chocolate malted grains, and heavy body. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Java Sunda Siki Alit
coffees.description: This wet process Java offers a nice counter point to rustic wet hulled lots, caramelized sweetness, balanced roast tones, brown spice, hint of acidity, big body, bittersweet finish. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Java Sunda Wet Hulled Laspada
coffees.description: Sweetness rides the line between dark sugar syrup, and malted caramel, with accents of pungent spices, foresty hints, umami accents and medium body that thickens as it cools. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Java Sunda Wet Hulled Laspada
coffees.description: Moderately sweet wet hulled coffee that works at a wide range of roasts, even light! Malt syrup, citrus accent, smoked chocolate, and complex aroma of herbal bitters, and woodsy spice hints. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Java Sunda Wet Hulled Rancabali
coffees.description: Rancabali has just what we look for in quality wet hulled coffee, like syrupy body, deep-toned bass notes, rustic sweetness, herbaceous aroma, and a long lasting finish. City+ to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Java Sunda Wet Hulled Siki Alit
coffees.description: Fans of wet hulled Sumatran coffees should take note. Resonant low tones, thick body, leather, toasted barley, eucalyptus and cedar, and a long, bittersweet aftertaste. Full City to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Java Sunda Wet Process Siki Alit
coffees.description: Clean washed Javanese coffee with forward sweetness, and subtle aromatic notes. Profiles of caramelized sugars, buttery caramel, lemon-lime twist, dark chocolate bar with crisped rice. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Kenya Dry Process Nyeri Burumani
coffees.description: This dry process coffee packs intense sweetness and wild fruits, fermented berry, cider vinegar, red punch, burnt sugars, and boomy cocoa notes underneath. One to sip and take in rather than go at with gusto! City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Embu Kathakwa Peaberry
coffees.description: Sweetness and acidity are what I keyed in on in the cup, with subtle hints of fruity tea, bright citrus, and aromatic baking spices. Long, sweet finish accented by notes of burnt sugar and green herbs. City to City+.

coffees.title: Kenya Kiambu Spike AA
coffees.description: This AA separation builds a vibrant structure of citrus tones, tangy fruits, with a sweetly-spiced aroma that lingers in the aftertaste. Brown sugar, maple, juicy muscat grape, dried tamarind, and Five Spice. City to City+.

coffees.title: Kenya Kiambu Spike AA Lot 2
coffees.description: Sweetness forward, with well integrated acidity and a sweetly-spiced aroma that lingers in the aftertaste. Notes of maple, blackberry tea, cranberry, goji berry, lemon, tannic tea-like finish. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Kiambu Spike AB
coffees.description: Cup flavors have a juicy quality, fruited and bright, but well integrated into the sweetness. Complexity comes up a bit as it cools, hints of dried currant, blackberry, long steeped black tea, aromatic finish. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Kiambu Spike AB
coffees.description: Great dark roasted Kenya, bittersweet, lightly fruited, and with complex rustic aroma. High % cacao bar, smoked chocolate, black currant, dried figs, tobacco leaf, and pepper cask aged coffee. Full City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Kenya Kiambu Spike Peaberry
coffees.description: Fruits are tame, which works well here, and keeps the focus on complex raw sugar sweetness, and dense body. Cools to mild mannered hints of cranberry, orange zest, spiced tea, and tamarind. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Kirinyaga Kainamui AB
coffees.description: Delicious light and dark roasted, flavors ranging from vibrant citrus, to dark dried fruits and rustc bittersweets. Notes of grapefruit, dark sugar, dried sultanas, caraway, and earth-toned incense. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Kenya Kirinyaga Kainamui Peaberry
coffees.description: A Kenya with complex fruits, and mouth pleasing interplay between acidity and juicy sweetness. Layered accents of spiced grape juice, cranberry-orange, black currant, and berry-flavored tea. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Kirinyaga Kamwangi Peaberry
coffees.description: Delicious fruit in both light and medium roasts, making it difficult to pick a favorite! Impressive level of sweetness, tart acidity, cherry lemonade, Darjeeling spiced tea, black currant, orange. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Kirinyaga Kamwangi Peaberry
coffees.description: City+ is a good starting point for deep sweetness that balances out fruit, and bittersweet tones. Rustic date sugar, dried plum, Medjool date, tart orange, baking spices, and aromatic wood. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Kenya Kirinyaga Karani Peaberry
coffees.description: Well-centered sweetness, with a mix of baking spice, dark caramel, and interesting peppery aspect to the flavors. Hints of shaved citrus, bell pepper, jalapeño jelly, blackberry, strong mulling spice notes. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Kirinyaga Kiamugumo Peaberry
coffees.description: Layers of juicy flavors, syrupy sweetness, and complex aroma as it cools. Apple tones come through in cup sweetness and refreshing acidity, accented by notes of green grape, black currant tea, and stone fruit. City to City+.

coffees.title: Kenya Kirinyaga Kiangoi AA
coffees.description: A dynamic cup with big sweetness, juicy fruits and aromatic spice notes. Raw cane sugar is accented by well-integrated notes of grape, red berries, punchy orange acidity, finishing hints of clove and cinnamon. City to City+.

coffees.title: Kenya Meru Kinjo AB
coffees.description: Leads with rustic sugar sweetness in the cup, cooling to moderate hints of fruits and well-integrated acidity. Date sugar, molasses, canned plum, bittering tea and cocoa finish. City to Full City. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Kenya Muranga Kangunu AA
coffees.description: Well-developed sweetness in the brew, with mouth-refreshing acidity. Sugar cane juice, candied lemon peel, tropical tea spiced accents of ginger and coriander powders, hop-like florals and rose hips. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Muranga Kangunu AB
coffees.description: Complex cup sweetness accented by hints of fruit and spices, with well integrated acidity for the origin. Notes of sugarcane juice, orange, tamarind, peach tea, fennel, ginger tea with lemon. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Muranga Kangunu Peaberry
coffees.description: Sweet at its core, with an array of fruit accents, moderate tartaric/citric acidity, and ample body that deepens with roast. Hints of currant, lemon rind, peach, fruit leather, whole spice, and cocoa. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Muranga Ndiara AA
coffees.description: Decadent sweetness carries an elegant side, a cup laced with cleanly sweet flavors of caramel glaze and sugar in the raw, red apple, citrus hints of lemon and Naval orange, and a spiced honey aroma. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Chinga Peaberry
coffees.description: Shows complex fruited accents, aromatic spice, and acidity that shines bright. Notes of tart cranberry, black currant, grabby grapefruit, stone fruit, clove and cinnamon stick. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Gachatha Peaberry
coffees.description: Fruited intensity, with deep sweet undertones of cooked sugars and a bright top end. Notes of juicy grapefruit, Marionberry, dried tamarind, mulled grape juice, currant jam, grabby citrus peel. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Gaikundo AA
coffees.description: Raw sugar sweetness and mouth refreshing acidity lie at the heart of Gaikundo's cup profile, with pronounced flavors of raw sugars, high-toned citrus accents, orange, grapefruit, and tart rose hips tea. City to City+.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Gathaithi Peaberry
coffees.description: Punchy and bright when light roasted, and should work wonders as pour-over brew and iced coffee. Tonal aspects of citrus and fresh berry, hints of juicy orange, tart peach, grapefruit, and cantaloupe melon. City to City+.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Gatomboya AA
coffees.description: Transparent sweetness beneath an array of top note accents, with snappy citric side that brings a bracing quality to the brew. Light hints of simple syrup, tangerine, apricot, shaved lemon, grapefruit, cranberry, tannic black tea. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Gatugi AB
coffees.description: Middle roast levels are well suited for this Kenya, where juicy body, and bittersweetness are prominently featured, along with notes of black plum, tamarind sauce and lime zest. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Gichathaini AB
coffees.description: Moderate complexity in the light roasts, with acidity and top note accents that are integrated into the underlying sweetness. Brown sugars, citrus, stone fruit, baking spices, and hop water aroma. City to City+.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Gichathaini Peaberry
coffees.description: Pleasantly fruited Kenya that yields complex aromatic flavors and a bright top end. Hints of grape, black plum, candied ginger, raw cane sugar, Chai spiced tea, and tangy zested lemon. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Gichichi AA
coffees.description: Vibrant profile of bright fruits and well-developed sweetness at a surprising range of roast levels, with notes of peach, tart plum tea, grape, clove and ginger candies, tannic tea, and fragrant hops. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Ichamama Peaberry
coffees.description: There's a broad range of flavor profiles unlocked at different roast levels. From lighter, brighter tones to juicy dark fruits with deeper roast development. Hints of citrus, red fruits, and mulling spices. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Igutha AB
coffees.description: Pour-overs are a real treat, with bright fruits and tangy accents that feel well integrated into the cup sweetness, and an aromatic top end. P iloncillo sugar, orange, green apple, tamarind, Earl Grey, cardamom . City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Igutha Peaberry
coffees.description: Cup sweetness is brightly accented by notes of citrus and spices that feel fairly well balanced for Kenyan coffee. Profiles of brown sugar, lemon, golden raisin, spiced sodas like Dr Pepper, tea bittering finish. City to City+.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Kaiguri AA
coffees.description: Sweetness-driven Kenya that's not all high tones. A middle ground between layered raw sugars and brightly accented hints of citrus and black tea. Makes a great chocolate-laden dark roast too. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Kamoini AA
coffees.description: A snappy, "light and bright" Kenya profile, syrupy sweetness, sweet citrus tones like lemonade sweetened with raw sugar, pink grapefruit, aromatic hints of Meyer lemon, baking spice, and black tea. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Kamoini AB
coffees.description: Versatile Kenya. Light roasts have a bright, tea-like quality with plump fruit accents and spiced aroma, traded for dark toned chocolate and sticky dried fruits at darker levels. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Kamoini Peaberry
coffees.description: This juicy peaberry lot is underscored by plump fruit and berry notes, with spiced aromatics and a bright acidic snap. Notes of black currant, grapefruit, tangy plum, cranberry lemonade, Allspice. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Kangocho AB
coffees.description: Kangocho is such a pleasure to take your time drinking, the complex flavors build as it cools, and bright acidity adds a heightened intensity to the profile. Citrus, baking spice, hop water, long-steeped black tea. City to City+.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Kangocho Peaberry
coffees.description: Light roasts yield sweet raw sugar flavors layered with spice notes and hints of fruit, and bright citrus-like acidic impression. Notes of demerara, date syrup, mulled cider, tangerine, melon, and clove tea. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Karindundu AB
coffees.description: Light roasts draw out snappy acidity, and mouth-cleansing citrus notes like orange and grapefruit, along with dried lemongrass, black tea, toasted sugar, subtle herbal and spice hints in the aftertaste. City to City+.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Karindundu Peaberry
coffees.description: Well-developed sweetness, with fruit and spiced accents, and a bright spark of acidity. Profiles of raw sugars, raisin, black currant, Bergamot peel, Darjeeling tea and clove. City to Full City. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Karuthi AA
coffees.description: Brightly accented sweetness, with brisk flavors that bring out a very nice interplay between sweetness and acidity. Clean raw sugars, black tea, lemon, orange, baking spice, mouth refreshing. City to City+.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Kiaguthu Peaberry
coffees.description: Bright citric acidity and spiced sweetness in the cup, with solid core bittersweet base flavor that's accented by notes of tangerine, grabby grapefruit, and coriander-spiced Belgian ale in the nose. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Kiamabara AB
coffees.description: Very sweet Kenya, juicy and moderately complex, with citrus notes that are more sweet than bright. Notes of lemonade, orange cream soda, apricot jam, and lovely acidity that doesn't overpower the cup. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Maganjo Peaberry
coffees.description: Aromatic cup when roasted light, fruited and fragrantly spiced, with high perceived acidity and aromatic finish. Hints of yellow cherry, lemon grass tea, warming spice, hops, and citrus rind. City to City+.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Mahiga AB
coffees.description: Tartly sweet flavors are overlaid with spiced complexity and bright fruits. Notes of currant juice, cranberry sauce, Darjeeling and Orange spice teas, cardamom, fragrant lemongrass, mulled juice. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Mahiga AB
coffees.description: Tartly-sweet note of black currant at the front of the cup, and moves into citrus accents of orange, and lemongrass, herbaceous hints, baking spices, mulled grape, and cocoa. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Mutheka AB
coffees.description: Light roasts satisfied our taste for a brightly-sweet Kenya's, and Full City proved to brew a standout espresso. Juicy texture, apple, pomegranate, Turkish Delight candies and brown sugar. City to Full City. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Mutwewathi AA
coffees.description: Syrupy mouthfeel and citrus acidity carried the cup of our City+ roasts, where broad sweetness leads to flavor profiles of unrefined sugars and lemon pastry hints. City+ to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Ndaroini AA
coffees.description: Persistent sweetness that falls on the line of raw sugars/caramelized sugars, with hints of red berries, orange, whole spices, and bittersweet undertones that can be developed with roast. City to Full City. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Rukira AA
coffees.description: Aromatic cup flavors and juicy accents are highlighted in light roasts. The sweetness is marked by complex notes of b erry, pomegranate, tangy citrus, vanilla and a fragrant finish that's tannic and tea-like. City to City+.

coffees.title: Kenya Nyeri Rukira Peaberry
coffees.description: A cup with fruit-accented sweetness and finishing hints of aromatic spice and tannic tea-like notes that pull at your tongue. I loved my Full City roast, where dark currant and tangy roast tones coalesce. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Othaya Gatuyaini AA
coffees.description: An undercurrent of complex sweetness leads to flavor profiles of spiced sugar, molasses cookie, accents of dried ginger, apricot tea, coriander, and lively citrus acidity. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Othaya Gatuyaini AB
coffees.description: Transparent sweetness and incredible aromatics, with juicy notes of tangy citrus, champagne grape, red fruits, and fragrant hints of Darjeeling tea, cardamom spice, and dried wild flowers. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Kenya Thika Karatu Peaberry
coffees.description: Brightly accented flavors with spiced sweetness underneath, hints of Cola, complimentary vanilla note, citrus, black currant, ginger chews, whole spices like star anise and mace in the finish. City to City+.

coffees.title: Kenya Thika Karatu Peaberry Lot 2
coffees.description: Medium roasts proved to brew excellent brewed coffee and espresso, syrupy bittersweetness propped up by tart flavors of citrus and red berry, with zesty accents and rustic dried fruit. City+ to Full City. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Laos Paksong Hills Catigua Variety
coffees.description: Presents a nice daily driver, rounded sweetness with mild bright aspects that connect to quietly present top notes of green herb, baked fruit, and bittersweet finish. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Laos Paksong Hills Gesha
coffees.description: This coffee may note scream "Gesha" in the cup, but there are certainly delicate aromatic aspects, including notes of jasmine. Light roast treatment is a must for hints of floral tea, fruit tones, and juicy acidity. City.

coffees.title: Laos Paksong Hills Typica Variety
coffees.description: The cup flavors are nicely balanced and sweet, with a slight fruit tone that brings subtle dimension to the overall picture. Caramel, brown sugar, berry tea, lemon hint. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Mexico Chiapas La Ramona
coffees.description: Ticks off the boxes of a crowd-pleasing brew - balanced sweetness, nutty hints, with modest acidity and dark-toned cocoa. Hints of malt syrup, toffee almond, lemon tea, bittersweet cocoa. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Mexico Chiapas Villa Corzo
coffees.description: Modest Chiapas profile of sweet nutty hints, moderate low tones, and acidity on the quieter side. Burnt sugar, pistachio bar, chocolate almond granola, lingering bittering roast tones. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Mexico Organic Chiapas WP Decaf
coffees.description: Brews a clean decaf cup, crowd-pleasing, malty-sweet, and chocolate-toned. Notes of molasses bread, cinnamon, matcha tea, malted beer grains, and chocolate almond. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Mexico Organic Granjeros Chiapas WP Decaf
coffees.description: A more delicate decaf but full of flavor nonetheless. Sweetness is persistent through the finish, cane sugar, tea accented with dried lemon peel, graham cracker, spiced cocoa. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Mexico Organic Granjeros de Chiapas
coffees.description: A crowd pleasing coffee at a wide roast range. Light roast are cleanly sweet, caramel, accents of praline nuts, and candied pecan. Dark roasts are deep-toned, smokey cocoa, dark chocolate, and cacao nibs. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Mexico Sierra Madre WP Decaf
coffees.description: Pleasantly dark-toned sweetness starting around City+ that carries over into cocoa-laden brews at darker levels, with malty hints, brown sugar, chocolate-covered nut. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Mexico Sierra Madre de Chiapas
coffees.description: This isn't an outlandish coffee, but a very attractive one to sip, with clarity in the flavors, modest intensity, and a crisp, clean finish. Raw sugar, cocoa roast tones, cinnamon bread, almond, flash of orange spice tea. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Mexico Tenejapa Valle de Jovel
coffees.description: Balanced profile with restrained sweetness of unrefined sugars, hefty cocoa roast flavors, accents of loose leaf tea and walnut oil, hints of apple and smoked chocolate. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Mexico Veracruz Huatusco
coffees.description: Balanced flavors in the middle roasts with-to-nutty accents, and subtle acidic impression that are sure to garner wide appeal. Cane sugar, pistachio, dried lemon peel, and tea. City+ to Full City.

coffees.title: Nicaragua Acopio Suyatal
coffees.description: Versatile coffee, simple sweetness accented by vanilla and walnut, with core bittersweet tones that are easily developed with roast. Crowd-pleasing flavors will also pair well with cream. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Nicaragua Buenos Aires Java
coffees.description: This unique Java cultivar has hints of long steeped black tea, chocolate malted grains, high toned accents of candied lemon with some grabby zested citrus peel, and resonant caramel sweetness. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Nicaragua Buenos Aires Java
coffees.description: This unique Java cultivar has lasting sweetness and a refined, delicate aroma, with high toned accents of black tea, apricot, candied lemon, grabby zested citrus peel, and sweet finish. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Nicaragua Buenos Aires Maracaturra
coffees.description: City+ splits the difference between subtle aromatics and fully fleshed out sweetness that comes with a bit more roast development. Notes of brown sugar, Assam tea, marzipan, and clove. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Nicaragua Buenos Aires Maracaturra
coffees.description: City+ splits the difference between subtle aromatics and fully fleshed out sweetness that comes with a bit more roast development. Notes of caramel, Assam tea, marzipan, and zested orange. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Nicaragua Buenos Aires Peaberry
coffees.description: Such a pleasant brew in the middle roasts, bass notes are balanced by moderate sweetness, accented by hints of caramel, creamy nut, dark cocoa, and zested citrus. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Nicaragua Dipilto Monte Libano
coffees.description: The roast levels we tried did little to knock base bittersweetness out of balance. Deep cocoa roast tones open up to hints of walnut, vanilla, anise, and pungent burnt sugar. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Nicaragua Dry Process La Laguna
coffees.description: Fruit-forward with a complex rustic side, big body, natural dried apricot, tamarind, fruit liqueur, chocolate cherry, honey-nut, long bittersweet finish. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Nicaragua Dry Process Maracaturra
coffees.description: Rustic fruit flavors bring some brightness to the top end, with notes of dried berry and stone fruit, fermented hints, fruit shrub drink, and tannic bittering in the finish. City to City+.

coffees.title: Nicaragua Finca Buenos Aires
coffees.description: Always a crowd pleasing brew, Buenos Aires displays moderate sweetness and punchy cocoa tones, accented by hints of chocolate-covered pumpkin seeds, nut, and vanilla. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Nicaragua Honey Process Maracaturra
coffees.description: We found this honey lot shows very well in middle and darker roasts, where syrupy body gives way to bittersweet profiles, like black cocoa and dark chocolate wafers, accented by hints of fruit and spice. City+ to Full City+.

coffees.title: Nicaragua Los Alpes
coffees.description: This Caturra lot from Los Alpes is well-rounded and crowd-pleasing, with the kind of bittersweet profile that's great as black coffee, or paired with cream. Brown sugar, almond, Dutch cocoa, apple. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Nicaragua Los Alpes Caturra
coffees.description: Shows well at a wide range of roasts, moderately sweet with caramel impressions, bright accents in light roasts, and high potential for bittersweetness body at darker levels. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Nicaragua Maracaturra Los Medios
coffees.description: This medium-sized bean separation of Maracaturra carries the same delicate aromatic aspects of its larger counterpart, with an underlay of caramel sweetness, baking spice, lemongrass and herbal accents. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Nicaragua Maracaturra Los Medios
coffees.description: Sweet center of caramel and brown sugar flavors are accented by faint aromatic top notes that crop up as the coffee cools. Hints of citrus, powdered ginger, roasted barley, lemongrass, and basil. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Nicaragua Ojo de Agua
coffees.description: Chocolate-toned coffee, with slightly fruited acidity that structures the cup. Brown sugar candy, praline almond, vanilla, milk chocolate, toasted coconut, citrus, and green apple. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Nicaragua Ojo de Agua
coffees.description: Crowd-pleasing cup, moderate sweetness, hints of praline almond, vanilla, and cocoa. Bittersweet chocolate tones can really be dialed up in dark roasts. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Panama Bambito Estate Typica
coffees.description: Very pleasant in the light-to-medium roasts, low intensity, moderately sweet brew, with a touch of citrus acidity, burnt sugar, creamy Macadamia nut, toasty Genmaicha tea, and cocoa. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Papua New Guinea Korgua Peaberry
coffees.description: Thick body across the roast spectrum, rustic bittersweet notes and hints of natural sweeteners, sorghum, dried date, tamarind, green herbal aroma, and tannic tea-like finish. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Papua New Guinea Organic Goroka SWP Decaf
coffees.description: Versatile in the roaster, balanced chocolate tones and positive acidity for decaf coffee. Notes of rice syrup, tarragon, citrus, dark cocoa, chipotle and black sesame. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Peru Diamante Roger Chilcon
coffees.subregion: El Diamante, San Jose de Lourdes
coffees.description: Complex sweetness of natural sugars and malt syrup, with contrasting hints of dried fruit, tangy citrus, and delicately spiced aroma that brings interest to the cup profile. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Peru FTO Alto Mayo WP Decaf
coffees.description: City+ proved to be a good starting point to draw out sweetness, notes of cinnamon roll, cocoa, malted beer grain, and a coriander spice notes brought a delicate aspect to the aroma. City+ to Full City.

coffees.title: Peru FTO Chirinos Coop SWP Decaf
coffees.description: City+ is a good starting point, but this coffee showed very positive bittersweet notes up to the start of 2nd Crack. Simple, versatile decaf, brown sugar, dark truffle, herbal hints. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Peru Huabal El Paraíso
coffees.description: Crowd-pleasing in the middle roasts, a backdrop of bittersweetness contrasts sweet caramel notes, creamy body, and apple-like acidic impression. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Peru Huabal Mario Rafael
coffees.description: Sweet-nutty flavor profile with fruited accents that comes off like almonds drizzled in dark caramel, hazelnut spread with a hint of spice, dried green apple, and cinnamon hot cocoa. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Peru Huabal San Pablo
coffees.description: Balanced flavors, layered profiles of brown sugar, torrone, butter pecan, and honey. Darker roasts pull out deep chocolate tones, satiny body, with hints of clove, and saffron. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Peru Huabal San Pablo
coffees.description: Very versatile. Light roasts have layers of honey, brown sugar, torrone, with hints of apple, and citrus. Darker roasts pull out chocolate tones accented by spice, with satiny body. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Peru Jaén El Huaco
coffees.description: Pleasantly sweet flavors of honey and butterscotch, with notes of bittersweet chocolate bar, toasted almond, a ribbon of caramel, and hints of apple and peach tea play into the acidic impression. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Peru Organic Dry Process Guardian del Bosque Gesha
coffees.subregion: Gracias a Dios, Lonya Grande, Amazonas
coffees.description: Unique amalgam of both heavy-handed fruits and soft aromatic florality of Gesha as it cools. Resiny sweetness, dried strawberry, fruit syrup, freesia blossom, creamy tropical mangosteen, and Fruit Loops cereal. City to City+.

coffees.title: Peru Organic Guardian del Bosque Gesha
coffees.subregion: Gracias a Dios, Lonya Grande, Amazonas
coffees.description: Brings a light floral overlay to softly rounded sweetness, accents of fruit, and aromatic bittering of green herbs. Hints of simple syrup, jasmine, apple, dried orange peel, green tea, hops, and lemon balm. City to City+.

coffees.title: Peru Organic Honey Guardian del Bosque Gesha
coffees.subregion: Gracias a Dios, Lonya Grande, Amazonas
coffees.description: Honey processing draws out fruit-accented sweetness in this Gesha coffee, with tropical hints, passion fruit and guava, rustic dried date, and fragrant aromatics that offer both floral highlights and intriguing resinous notes. City to City+.

coffees.title: Peru Perlamayo Familia Rioja
coffees.description: Syrupy sweetness is marked by fruited top notes, apple filling, pear, brown sugar, and the slight bittering of fruit peel. Dark roasts show notes of dark chocolate with a hint of plum. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Peru Productores de Jaén
coffees.description: This small producer blend offers familiar bittersweet flavors, and thick body that performs well as both brewed coffee and espresso. Milk chocolate, semi sweet chips, creamy nut, milky body. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Peru Productores del Diamante
coffees.description: A striking caramelized bittersweet note sets the tone in the cup, with hints of unrefined sugars, dried apple, almond granola, dark cocoa, roast toned finish. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Rwanda Anaerobic Karambi
coffees.description: Refined for anaerobic process, cleanly spiced sweetness, dense body, and lemon-like acidity that structures the cup profile. Complex aromatic components, like Belgian ale, dried coriander, and clove-spiked tea. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Rwanda Dry Process Gitwe
coffees.description: Profiles of dried fruits and berries are core flavors, along with bittersweet intensity that offers a nice counterpoint to some of the wilder aspects. Apricot, fruit leather, cardamom, chicory, chocolate coconut. City+ to Full City+.

coffees.title: Rwanda Dry Process Karongi Gitesi
coffees.description: Dynamic fruits and berry notes, with the kind of spiced aroma we often experience in coffees from Rwanda. Blueberry accented sweetness, Karo syrup, dried mango, Medjool date, black tea, bittering whole spices. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Rwanda Dry Process Kivu Kageyo
coffees.description: Fans of fruity coffees should put dry process Kageyo on their short list! Expansive profiles of juicy fruit flavors, notes of blueberry, green melon, peaches, tropical mango, Medjool date, and strawberry preserves. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Rwanda Dry Process Macuba
coffees.description: Deeply sweet dry process, with fruited accents, syrupy body, and brooding low tones when roasted dark. Molasses, spice cake, raisins and dates, red berry, plum wine, layers of bittersweet chocolate. City+ to Full City+.

coffees.title: Rwanda Dry Process Tumba
coffees.subregion: Tumba Town, Rulindo District, Northern Province
coffees.description: Berry-toned sweetness and acidity, aromatic accents, and tea-like tannic notes that lend to a cleansing aspect in the mouthfeel. Notes of lingonberry, blackberry tea, dried raspberry, clove oil, garam masala. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Rwanda Honey Process Gatare
coffees.description: Balanced flavors and vivid cup clarity, core honeyed sweetness, with well integrated acidity. Accents of lemon black tea, golden raisin, candied orange, tannic tea-like finish. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Rwanda Honey Process Kibirizi
coffees.description: "Honey" refers to process method, but also happens to be an appropriate descriptor for sweetness in the cup. Red honey, accents of brown sugar, nutmeg, cinnamon, brisk black tea, lemon spritz. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Rwanda Milles Collines Peaberry
coffees.description: Syrupy sweet at range of roasts, brightly accented top notes, mouth-pleasing texture, and spiced finish. Caramel, semi-sweet chocolate, tea, dried lemon, coriander, cinnamon bark. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Rwanda Milles Collines Peaberry Lot 2
coffees.description: Foundational sweetness accented by fragrant notes of Rooibos tea, whole spices, floral chamomile, lively notes of apricot tea, and orange. Small bean size not recommended for Behmor grid drums. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Rwanda Nyamasheke Coproca
coffees.description: Balanced flavors at a range of roasts, layered sweetness, sparkling acidity in light roasts, and delicate aroma. Broad bittersweetness when roasted dark, with a hint of dried fruit. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Rwanda Nyamasheke Gatare
coffees.description: Aromatic sweetness of caramel and baking spice, with a light citrus oil note that plays into the acidic impression. Hints of brown sugar, pear, cinnamon roll, and a shimmer of sweat tea. City to Full City. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Rwanda Nyamasheke Gitwe
coffees.description: This year's lot has memorable vibrance when roasted light, with notes of complex sugars, honey, lemon, tart dried apple, cinnamon tea, all spice, honey, brisk black tea, and mouth cleansing finish. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Rwanda Nyamasheke Gitwe
coffees.description: Classic Rwanda cup, sweetness holds up at a wide range of roasts, brown sugar, bright citrus, tea-like aroma, syrupy chocolate at darker levels, dense mouthfeel, and hint of warming spice. City to Full City+. Good for espresso

coffees.title: Rwanda Nyamasheke Karambi
coffees.description: City roasts won me over, layered sweetness interspersed with hints of spice, and bright citrus. Brown sugar, Dulce de Leche, maple, buckwheat, five spice, lemon juice, and aromatic lemongrass tea. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Rwanda Nyamasheke Nyungwe
coffees.description: Interplay of sweetness and vivid bright tones, with a spiced aroma we've come to expect from Rwanda. Butterscotch, black tea, all spice, vanilla, lightly bittering citrus, and Dr Pepper. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Rwanda Rulindo Buliza
coffees.description: Cup sweetness is interspersed with flashes of acidity, and top note accents gain clarity as the coffee cools. Minimally processed sugars, cherry cola, fruited brightness. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Rwanda Rulindo Tumba
coffees.subregion: Tumba Town, Rulindo District, Northern Province
coffees.description: Abundant sweetness and balanced roast tones make Tumba a super versatile coffee. Light roasts have a delicate side too, moderately bright, with traces of spice, berries, black tea, and citrus. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Rwanda Rulindo Tumba 2
coffees.subregion: Tumba Town, Rulindo District, Northern Province
coffees.description: Abundantly sweet and versatile coffee, marked by notes of brown sugar and cane juice, lively citrus, aromatic tea notes, pomegranate, fragrant baking spices, and mouth-cleansing finish. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Rwanda Rusizi Mushaka
coffees.description: Complex sweetness, spiced aroma, and illuminating acidity. Notes of brown sugar, English Breakfast tea, candied citrus, sarsaparilla, apple, cinnamon stick, and burnt sugar finish. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Rwanda Rusizi Mushaka
coffees.description: A cup with layered sweetness and thick body, mildly bright accents that hint at citrus when roasted light, and syrupy bittersweets at darker levels. Honey, black tea, malted grains, spiced cocoa. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Rwanda Rutsiro Mushonyi
coffees.description: A sweet, bright Rwandan coffee with flavors of syrupy dark honey, aromatic Earl Grey, cinnamon apple tea, clove spice, and complex acidic impressions of citrus and strawberry. Nice dark roasted too! City to Full City.

coffees.title: Rwanda Rutsiro Nkora
coffees.description: Flavors find parity with many of our high grown Guatemalan coffees. Well-balanced, rounded flavors, syrupy-sweetness, and moderate acidity. Hints of dried fruit, tea, cinnamon bark, and dark cocoa. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.description: Our sample sets offer broad selection and big savings, perfect for those new to home coffee roasting and seasoned veterans alike! coffees.title: Set: Fruit Basket Flavor Set
coffees.description: Fruit flavors are the theme, featuring coffees that exemplify the many ways fruity notes manifest in coffee flavor profiles. This set includes 1 lb each from four different origins, and often different process methods, all at a discounted price!

coffees.title: Set: Latest Coffee Additions
coffees.description: Our "Latest Additions" coffee set gets you 1 lb bags of all our latest listings. No jumping back and forth between different records to add them to your shopping cart. Simply click the "Add to Cart" button and you're on your way. It's that simple!

No need to do all the research either, we do…

coffees.title: Set: Regular Green Coffee Sampler
coffees.description: Our sample sets offer broad selection and big savings, perfect for those new to home coffee roasting and seasoned veterans alike! Starting off with a sample set is an economical way to try coffees from around the world, and explore different flavors with just 1 click. No need to do all the research either, we do that for you, grouping together coffees that are relatively easy to roast from distinct growing regions.…

coffees.title: Sulawesi Aged Dry Process Napu Robusta
coffees.description: Bass notes dominate, but aging the coffee has smoothed out the bittering 'bite'. Baking cocoa, low sweetness and acidity, inky body, earthy hints, and savory umami notes. Full City+ to French. Good for espresso. *2# limit per customer

coffees.title: Sulawesi Dry Process Desa Topidi
coffees.description: Intense dry process flavors, layers of winey fruits and tangy chocolate roast notes, hints of currant tea, plum wine, fruit liqueurs, bittering cocoa powder, tobacco, brown ale, and big body. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Sulawesi Honey Enrekang Angin Angin
coffees.description: Deep bass toned cup, thick body that unfolds to malty sweetness, and a pungent bittersweet finish. Notes of stout beer, burnt sugar, Chai spice, and drinking cocoa with cinnamon. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sulawesi Kahayya Village
coffees.description: Herbal sweet notes of horehound candy and Ricola, accented by tobacco, foresty peat, bittering cocoa, woody whole clove, and rounded mouthfeel. Intense low tones in darker roasts. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sulawesi Tana Luwu Tibussan Village
coffees.description: Classic balance and clean cup flavors, brightly accented bittersweet tones that fit well within the flavor map of washed Latin American coffees. Very versatile coffee! City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sulawesi Wet Hulled Messawa Pak Yulias
coffees.description: Thick body and low acidity draw attention to foresty rustic notes and deep toned roast flavors. Dark cocoa, mossy peat, scorched wood, leather, loose leaf tobacco, long, bittersweet finish. Full City to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sulawesi Wet Hulled Toraja Pango Pango
coffees.description: Classic wet hulled flavors, herbaceous and foresty, balanced out by low toned intensity, a touch of acidity in light roasts, sharp bittersweets, incredibly thick body and long finish. City+ to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sumatra Aged Gayo - 5 Year Vintage
coffees.description: Intense flavors, heavy body, bittersweet and rustic profile, burnt marshmallow, oak barrel, mossy peat, tobacco, baking chocolate, strong tea bittering, brown spices, hickory smoke. Full City to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sumatra Aged Lintong - 5 Year Vintage
coffees.description: Aged coffees yield intensely rustic flavors that tend to please the wet hulled coffee crowd. Earthy aroma, pungent bittering, brown spices, tobacco, cedar, pepper cask, thick body, and more. City+ to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sumatra Anaerobic Washed Bebesen Aulia
coffees.description: For anaerobic coffee, this lot packs more bittersweet intensity than fruit. Brews balanced flavors and thick body, pungent roast tones, bean to bar chocolate, tannic tea, very long finish. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sumatra Dry Process Bebesen Aulia
coffees.description: Rustic complexity, intense bittering tones take hold in the cup, with hints of acetic fruit, chocolate liqueur, tangy dried date, aromatic woody notes, and incredibly thick body. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sumatra Dry Process Kerinci Cooperative
coffees.subregion: Gunung Tujuh and Kayu Aro, Mount Kerinci
coffees.description: Intense flavors of syrupy fruits and earth-toned, pungent spice notes, with thick body, and a long aftertaste that's rustic and bittersweet. Stewed fruits, green apple, root-y sarsaparilla, fruity brandy, earthy raw cacao. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Sumatra Dry Process Kerinci Pendekar
coffees.subregion: Gunung Tujuh and Kayu Aro, Mount Kerinci
coffees.description: Syrupy sweetness underpins the cup, with pungent roast flavors and latent fruit accents. Notes of molasses, plum, dried fig, burnt sugar, dark-toned chocolates, and big, creamy body. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sumatra Dry Process Ribang Gayo
coffees.description: Big fruits, winey aroma, syrupy mouthfeel, and complex earth tones, this lot is a testament to the impact process method can have on flavor. Hints of fermented banana, spiced rum, burnt sugars, and cedar. City+ to Full City+.

coffees.title: Sumatra Giling Basah Aceh Pak Muhtar
coffees.description: Medium-to-dark roasts do a nice job framing bittersweet core flavors with rustic earth-toned aroma. Low acidity, thick body, dark cocoa, smokey peat, date, dried herb, tobacco. Full City to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sumatra Giling Basah Bebesen Aulia
coffees.description: Rustic sweetness and incredible depth of flavor, rice syrup, raw brown sugars, pungent earth-tones, intense bittersweetness, herbal aroma, foresty flavors in the finish. City+ to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sumatra Giling Basah Gegarang Aulia
coffees.description: Excellent dark roast, brooding bass tones, pungent sweetness, earth toned accents, tobacco, extra dark chocolate, torched sugar, roasted barley, woody whole spices, thick satiny body. Full City to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sumatra Giling Basah Sesongot
coffees.description: Rustic sweetness and incredible depth of flavor, with notes of rice syrup, pungent earth-tones, bittersweet intensity, accents of sweet grains and fruit, herbal aroma, foresty finish. City+ to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sumatra Honey Process Kerinci Pendekar
coffees.description: Complex sweetness cuts through bittersweet low tones, with notes of rustic palm sugar, barley malt, chocolate orange, herbal sweet accents, and thick body. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sumatra Lintong Sigumpar Village
coffees.description: This wet hulled coffee shows classic Lintong complexity, earth-toned, inky bittersweets, and about as heavy-bodied as coffee gets! Layers of dark cocoa, green herb notes, tobacco, aromatic wood. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sumatra Wet Hulled Aceh Pak Eki
coffees.description: Intense rustic flavors, inky body, dark bittersweetness is a central feature, low acidity, earth-toned aroma, accents of molasses, tobacco, peat, baking cocoa, aromatic wood. City+ to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sumatra Wet Hulled Aceh Tengah
coffees.description: Rustic earth-toned coffee, intense, brown rice syrup, alder incense, pine resin, tarragon, musky fruit hint, dense bittersweetness helps consolidate the flavors. Best with 48+ hours rest. City+ to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sumatra Wet Hulled Lake Tawar
coffees.description: The profile expands dramatically with roast, Full City being a great starting point for tenor-to-bass toned flavors, mild acidity, and rustic accents. Burnt sugar, smokey cedar, tobacco and spice. Full City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sumatra Wet Hulled Pak James
coffees.description: Rustic sweetness, malty roast notes, thyme and tarragon, tobacco, long, bittersweet finish, lingering hints of basil, and earthy peat. Intense flavors will stand up to milk too. City+ to Vienna. Good for espresso. Best with 72+ hours rest.

coffees.title: Sumatra Wet Hulled Pegasing Syahruna
coffees.description: Very nice wet hulled characteristics, earth-toned, punchy roast notes, low acidity and immense body. Notes of caramel, woody whole spices, cocoa nibs, charred cedar chips, and more. City+ to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sumatra Wet Hulled Ribang Gayo
coffees.description: Thick-bodied Sumatran cup, deep-toned and earthy at its core, pungent spice notes, intriguing cedar/tobacco aroma, and long finish with hints of leather and barrel-aged coffee. City+ to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sumatra Wet Process Kebun Gayo
coffees.description: Pleasantly simple cup, syrupy sweet, brown sugar with punchy roast flavors like Dutch cocoa, chocolate brownie, and mild acidity. Espresso shots are deep-toned with satiny texture. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sumatra Wet Process Kerinci Pendekar
coffees.description: Great example of wet process Indonesian coffee, not funky or earth-toned, but with moderately sweet, low-toned flavors, and a bracing quality that adds to the acidic impression. City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sumatra Wet Process Pantan Musara
coffees.description: Pungent bittersweet tones, torched sugar, dark cocoa, snappy rindy citrus note, chocolate malted grains, sage-infused dark chocolate. A profile for milk drinks, if there ever was one. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sweet Maria's 10 Speed Blend
coffees.description: Celebrating classic lines and versatility of the 10 Speed bicycle, this blend offers classic-toned flavors bittersweet and bright, and is extremely versatile in roasting and brew methods, including espresso. You could say it works great on all gears! City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sweet Maria's Altiplano Blend
coffees.description: Highlights the versatility of Central American coffees, balanced bittersweets, well-integrated acidity, rich chocolate, carbonized sugars, hints of nut and citrus. Blended with espresso in mind, but excellent brewed too. City+ to Full City+. Great for espresso

coffees.title: Sweet Maria's Decaf Espresso "Donkey" Blend
coffees.description: This decaf version of our Espresso Monkey blend targets chocolate roast flavors, sweet bright accents, medium body, and a slightly fruited side. Perfect on its own, and stands up to milk too! Full City to a light Vienna is recommended.

coffees.title: Sweet Maria's Espresso Monkey Blend
coffees.description: We blend this for body, balance between high and low tones, fruited-chocolate, slightly rustic fruit. Good espresso.

coffees.title: Sweet Maria's Ethiopiques Version 2.0
coffees.description: Velvety-textured shot, bittersweet and fruited, with a long lasting finish. Chocolate coated berry, raspberry laced truffles, hints of citrus, spiced cocoa, and creamy chocolate ganache. Full City to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sweet Maria's Liquid Amber Espresso Blend
coffees.description: A potent blend for espresso beverages, and ideal for milk drinks. Caramel sweetness turns pleasingly pungent; bittering spice, cacao, dark cocoa, savory notes, long aftertaste. Monsoon coffee and a small percentage of Robusta add crema and body. Full City+ to French roast. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sweet Maria's Moka Kadir Blend
coffees.description: The all dry process Moka Kadir blend offers an underpinning of rich chocolate low tones, rustic palm sugar-type sweetness, earthy dried fruits, velvety mouthfeel, and finishing hints that are bittersweet and leathery. Full City to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sweet Maria's New Classic Espresso
coffees.description: A classic, balanced espresso, but without the baggage of the old world espresso conventions... and without robusta!

coffees.title: Sweet Maria's Polar Expresso Holiday Blend
coffees.description: Creamy bittersweetness and punchy fruit accents coalesce in this year's blend, with notes of burnt caramel, raspberry, chocolate-covered orange, toasted graham cracker, and a long deep-toned finish. Full City to Full City+. Fantastic espresso!

coffees.title: Sweet Maria's Strange Beasts Espresso Blend
coffees.description: An unlikely coffee alliance yields balanced bittersweetness, well-integrated hints of fruit, baked goods, molasses, spice, and chocolate almond. Classic-toned, with velvety texture. Excellent straight or in milk drinks. Full City to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Sweet Marias Cordillera Central SWP Decaf
coffees.description: Remarkably sweet decaf with bright accents, caramel and raw sugars, apple top note, accents of tree nuts and rye, barley malt, and low-toned chocolatey base flavors. City to Full City+. Great decaf espresso!

coffees.title: Tanzania Mbozi Lukululu Peaberry
coffees.subregion: Lukululu town, Mlangali, Songwe, Mbozi District
coffees.description: Mouth refreshing and sweet, with a bright backbone of acidity that really pops. Lemon glaze accent brings a bracing quality, with notes of green tea with dried mango, yuzu citrus, and fresh green hops. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Tanzania Mbozi Mbewe Peaberry
coffees.description: Such an enjoyable East Africa cup profile, somewhere between the syrupy sweetness of Burundi and brighter toned Kenya coffee. Layered raw sugars, orange honey glaze, lemon tea, sweet finish. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Tanzania Mbozi Songwe AA
coffees.description: Very nice cup clarity, layered sweetness, and vivid, tea-like acidity. Shows an array of raw sugar flavors, accents of dried fruit and fragrant spices, and a brisk, mouth-cleansing finish. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Tanzania Ruvuma Makonga Peaberry
coffees.description: Sweet notes of honey and malt, lime-like acidity, orange tea, tangerine, citrus zest, light brown sugar note that lingers in the finish with a hint of sweetened black tea that cleanly disappears on the palate. City to Full City.

coffees.title: Timor Leste Aifu Ermera
coffees.description: Broad low tones, unrefined sweetness, and just a hint of acidity. Molasses, sorghum and corn syrups, notes of tobacco and roasted barley in the aftertaste. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso and milk drinks.

coffees.title: Uganda "Alpha" Commercial Grade Coffee
coffees.description: An opportunity to explore another side of coffee, infinitely interesting to see and taste. Earthy / root-like flavors with a touch of rustic sweetness, molasses, intensely bittering and pungent, roasted grains, chicory spice, cooked veggies. City+ to Full City+. *Limit 1 lb per customer.

coffees.title: Uganda Dry Process Bugoye Muramba
coffees.description: Intense dry process coffee, pungent roast tones, rustic sweetness, accents of prune, blackberry wine, honey mead, rustic dark chocolate, syrupy body, woody whole spices in the long finish. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Uganda Dry Process Masaka Robusta
coffees.description: Intense flavors, unsweetened baking chocolate, sharp cocoa, toasted grains, puffed wheat, roasted corn, chocolate beer malt, bitter clove oil, dried tarragon, low acidity. Full City to French. Good for espresso blending.

coffees.title: Uganda Kapchorwa Kabeywa
coffees.description: Light roasts brew balanced sweetness and structured flavors. Sweet notes of creamy caramel, dark toffee, and raw sugar, along with hints of lemon and dried goji berry that highlight acidity. City to City+.

coffees.title: Uganda Yellow Honey Kabeywa
coffees.description: Medium roasts brew bittersweet roast tones, buoyant body and a hint of acidity that brings a structured feel to the cup. Molasses, bran muffin, dark cocoa, aromatic wood, corn silk tea. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Yemen Al Qafr Hawari
coffees.description: This low-acid, thick-bodied Yemen is loaded with rustic-sweet flavors and richly bittersweet tones. Complex notes of Halva confections with pistachio and spices, tobacco, dried date, and cocoa. City+ to French. Excellent espresso.

coffees.title: Yemen Al Qafr Hawari
coffees.description: Rustic sweetness opens up to notes of brown beer, toasted sesame, Halva made with pistachio and spices. Deeply bittersweet dark roasts, with low acidity, and incedibly heavy body (10!). City+ to Vienna. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Yemen Khulani Amer
coffees.description: Fruit-accented profiles, intensely rustic and bittersweet coffee, notes of dark corn syrup, toasted grain, pumpkin bread, freeze dried fruit, leather, Cumin, bittering chocolate. City+ to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Yemen Mokha Haimi
coffees.subregion: Haima Dakhliya, and Kharijea Districts, Sana'a governorate
coffees.description: Baking spice notes make a strong showing, along with classic Yemeni flavors that are deep toned, earthy, and appropriately rustic. Fenugreek, saffron cookie, sesame oil, tangy roast flavors. City+ to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Yemen Mokha Haimi
coffees.subregion: Haima Dakhliya, and Kharijea Districts, Sana'a governorate
coffees.description: Excellent rustic complexity, tangy bittersweetness throughout, thick body, rustic sugars, woody aroma of whole spice and aromatic cedar, super long finish. Benefits from 48-72 hours rest. Full City to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Yemen Mokha Hajjah
coffees.subregion: Bani Awam and Mabyan Districts, Hajjah Governorate
coffees.description: Rustic sweetness and deep-toned flavors, with thick body that suits the pungent cup character. Molasses, rye, caramel popcorn, sesame chocolate, baking cocoa, tobacco, cedar chips. City+ to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Yemen Mokha Peaberry
coffees.description: Middle roasts bring out roast intensity interspersed with savory-sweet notes, aromatic hints, low acidity, and heavy body. Hazelnut chocolate, glazed nuts, whole spices, rustic tobacco. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Yemen Mokha Sanani
coffees.description: Intensely rustic, bittersweet flavors, lightly fruited, with body that's about as thick as coffee gets. Barley malt syrup, earthy dark chocolate, natural dried fruits, saffron cookie, fragrant wood and spices. City+ to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Yemen Mokha Sanani
coffees.description: Inky body, reverberant bass notes, natural dried fruit accents, woody whole spices, complex earth-toned aroma, and very long finish. Great for dark roasts and milk drinks. City+ to Full City+. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Yemen Sharqui Haraz
coffees.description: Intense cup, rustic-tinged sweetness, aromatic notes go from earth-toned to delicately spiced, thick body, mild acidity. Deeply bittersweet dark roasts, with traces of fruit and tobacco. City to French. Good for espresso.

coffees.title: Zambia Anaerobic Natural Misambo
coffees.description: A really "big" coffee in terms of overall intensity, fruit flavors and body. Fermented hints of berry kefir, kombucha, overripe orange, chocolate stout, with prominent bittersweetness in dark roasts. City to Full City+.

coffees.title: Zambia Kateshi Estate AA
coffees.description: Balanced roast intensity and sweetness, notes of brown sugar and pancake syrup fade to malted chocolate, bittering cocoa notes, and herbal aroma. Thick-bodied and bittersweet when roasted dark. City+ to Full City+.

coffees.title: Bali Blue Moon Organic
coffees.description: Named for the distinctive bluish green color imparted to the beans by the traditional local processing method, this coffee is consistently one of our most popular offerings. Big, bold and syrupy it's got generous notes of baker's chocolate with a touch of vanilla and an undertone of warm cedar and baking spices.

coffees.title: Bali Kintamani Natural Organic
coffees.description: Complex, sweet, rich...This coffee is from the same producers of our popular Bali Blue Moon. It's the exact same coffee except natural processed! Try them side by side for maximum effect. This natural version features the same big, rich body with sweet, intense notes of strawberry, raspberry, orange & cane sugar. It still has the earthy complexity with notes of baking spices like nutmeg and clove and leaves you…

coffees.title: Bolivia Caranavi Peaberry Organic
coffees.description: This incredibly rare find is an absolute treat to drink and roast! Balanced with a sparkling tang, it's got silky smooth texture and notes of Darjeeling tea, honey and lemon with a floral undertone. Perfect as an iced coffee for the summer! Arrival Date: June 15th, 2021 Acidity & Brightness: On the bright side, tangy Balance & Finish: Balanced , smooth finish Body & Texture: Medium to full body, silky Flavors…

coffees.title: Bolivia Caranavi San Juan Organic
coffees.description: This delightful coffee comes to us from the San Juan Coop in the Caranavi region of Bolivia. It's refreshingly bright, full bodied with a smooth finish and balanced sweetness. We noted crisp green apple, raspberry, marshmallow and lavender with a dark chocolate undertone. Perfect for a chilly spring morning or iced on a hot summer afternoon!

coffees.title: Bolivia Irupana Grober Mamani Honey Organic
coffees.description: This delicious Honey processed microlot from Finca Machacamarca is juicy and clean. It's got fairly gentle brightness and a flavor profile that suits these late summer/early fall months perfectly: peach, raisin and graham cracker. There's also a pleasant floral undertone along with a rich, creamy body.

coffees.title: Bourbon Bundle
coffees.description: It's very rare to get in coffees composed entirely of a single varietal and we have three of them in three different variants from three countries! Here's a chance to grab all of them to compare side by side. We're including a Guatemalan Red Bourbon, an El Salvadoran Orange Bourbon and a Colombian Pink Bourbon. Arrival Date: November 12th, 2021 ﻿Regions: ﻿Guatemala, El Salvador and Colombia Varietals: Bourbon…

coffees.title: Brazil Barra Grande Natural
coffees.description: This single estate coffee from Sitio Barra Grande is easy going and mild. It's very balanced and gentle with a sweet profile, creamy body and nutty finish. Perfect for those who prefer a gentle cup and for Italian style espresso blends. Arrival Date: ﻿February 27th, 2017 Acidity & Brightness: Low acidity and mild Balance & Finish: Well balanced, mild, nutty finish Body & Texture: Medium-full bodied, creamy…

coffees.title: Brazil Cerrado
coffees.description: This selection is a blend from producers of the Cerrado region of Brazil. It's graded as Fine Cup (FC) and Strictly Soft (SS) which is the highest cup category in Brazil. This is an excellent blender, especially for classic Italian style or Hydrid Espresso. It's got low acidity and a creamy texture with notes of cocoa powder, peanut and malt with just a hint of lemon.

coffees.title: Brazil FAF Caconde Serra Do Cigano
coffees.description: This coffee from FAF shows what Brazil coffee is truly capable of. In a country dominated by mono cropping, over farming and cheap, mass produced coffee, FAF (also known as Bob-O-Link) stands tall as a shining beacon of premium quality Brazilian coffee. This coffee is rich, creamy and balanced, all packaged in a delightfully clean cup. Look for big notes of toffee, peanuts, caramel and rich chocolate fudge.

coffees.title: Brazil Fazenda Saquarema Organic
coffees.description: This Organic selection from the Fazenda Saquarema is top notch. Perfect as an espresso or drip, it's got low acidity and a lingering peanut butter finish accompanied by notes of cocoa powder and almonds. Arrival Date: January 26th, 2018 Acidity & Brightness: Moderately low acidity, crisp front Balance & Finish: Slightly complex, lingering peanut butter finish Body & Texture: Medium bodied, silky mouthfeel Flavors…

coffees.title: Brazil Lagoinha Farm Yellow Bourbon
coffees.description: A beautifully selected Yellow Bourbon from Lagoinha Farm in Brazil, showcasing the naturally sweet and balanced character for which Brazilian specialty coffees are known. This coffee offers a smooth, rounded cup with a pleasant sweetness, approachable acidity and a rich, satisfying mouthfeel. A great choice for coffee drinkers who enjoy a classic Brazilian profile with added complexity and refinement.

coffees.title: Brazil Mogiana Natural
coffees.description: This selection comes to us from farmers in the world renowned Mogiana region of Brazil. It's graded as Fine Cup (FC) and Strictly Soft (SS) which is the highest cup category in Brazil. It's got low acidity and a creamy texture with notes of cocoa powder and walnut with just a hint of lemon. Arrival Date: August 17th, 2021 Acidity & Brightness: Low acidity, mildly sweet Balance & Finish: Slightly complex, lingering…

coffees.title: Brazil Mogiana Royal Select Water Decaf
coffees.description: "Royal Select" means the team at Royal coffee hand curated this decaf to be both delicious and an excellent representation of the Mogiana region. We found this Swiss Water Processed lot to be creamy and round with mild acidity and a tasty compliment of flavor notes: dark chocolate, graham cracker, raisin and peanuts. Excellent for Italian and Hybrid espresso blends!

coffees.title: Brazil Nossa Senhora da Medalha Natural
coffees.description: This yellow catuai lot comes to us from one of De La Finca's partner farmers: Bruno Henrique. Bruno has done a stellar job creating a cup that is lively and bright, rich and creamy and super clean. We noted green grape, key lime, honey, clementine and baker's chocolate.

coffees.title: Brazil Serra das Três Barras Red Catuai
coffees.description: With all of the coffee pouring out of Brazil, it can be difficult to find a really special one that stands out, but we feel confident we've found one here! This single estate coffee is super drinkable and makes for a great blender, especially in Italian style espressos. It is moderately complex, creamy and mildly bright with note of strawberry, peach, brown sugar and walnut. Arrival Date: ﻿February 5th, 2021…

coffees.title: Brazil Sitio Mortadella Yellow Catuai Natural
coffees.description: This single estate offering from the Barros family features the Yellow Catuai varietal. What's great about it is you're getting premium quality coffee without breaking the bank. The cup is balanced with a silky texture and clean finish with flavors of dark chocolate, caramel and dried fruit.

coffees.title: Brazil Sul de Minas Castanhas
coffees.description: A carefully selected and prepped coffee, this offering stands out in a sea of mediocre Brazilian coffees. Mild acidity and moderate complexity with a full body and creamy mouthfeel, this offering features subtle notes of green grape, cocoa powder and peanut. Arrival Date: ﻿October 9th, 2020 Acidity & Brightness: Moderately low acidity Balance & Finish: Moderately complex, lingering nutty finish Body & Texture…

coffees.title: Burundi A Kawazamurabawe
coffees.description: This delicious grade A crop from the Kawazamurabawe Coop (how's that for a mouthful?). It's subtle and gentle with pleasant notes of lime zest, white grapefruit and peach. Arrival Date: December 27th, 2017 Acidity & Brightness: Slightly crisp and sweet Balance & Finish: Very balanced, clean finish Body & Texture: Medium body, smooth Flavors: Lime zest, white grapefruit & peach Grade: A - Large Beans, very dense…

coffees.title: Burundi A Kayanza Matraco
coffees.description: This fantastic coffee comes to us Matraco, a Burundi producer who has won 4 cup of excellence awards in the last 6 years! You can taste the pedigree in this very balanced and delicious cup. Arrival Date: January 4th, 2019 Acidity & Brightness: Crisp and sweet Balance & Finish: Very balanced, clean finish Body & Texture: Medium body, smooth Flavors: Lime zest, nectarine, black tea and sugar Grade: A - Large Beans…

coffees.title: Burundi AA BUMOCO Society
coffees.description: This huge AA bean comes from the Burundi High Mountain Coffee Society (BUMOCO). It's crisp and tart with a full body and notes of green apple, lime and white grapefruit. Fans of African coffee will love this one for it's brightness and slight complexity. Arrival Date: January 20th, 2017 Acidity & Brightness: Crisp with a tart brightness Balance & Finish: Slight complexity with a clean finish Body & Texture: Medium…

coffees.title: Burundi Bundle
coffees.description: Both of our offerings from Burundi were made Crown Jewels by Royal Coffee! One is a natural process and the other is fully washed making for an excellent comparison of what the local bourbon cultivar is capable of. Regions: Muyinga Province and Ngozi Province, Burundi Varietals: Local Bourbon Cultivars Roasting: We like both of these coffees in the City to Full City range (light to medium). For the best comparison…

coffees.title: Burundi Kanovera A Fair Trade
coffees.description: This delicious grade A crop from the Kanovera Coop in the tiny African country of Burundi is sweet and balanced with notes of caramel, rhubarb and melon. Arrival Date: May 12th, 2016 Acidity & Brightness: Slightly crisp and sweet Balance & Finish: Very balanced, clean finish Body & Texture: Medium body, smooth Flavors: Caramel, rhubarb and honeydew Grade: A - Large Beans, very dense Certifications: Fair Trade…

coffees.title: Burundi Kayanza Giku Anaerobic Honey
coffees.description: When it came to choosing a anaerobic honey coffee to feature in our line up, we knew a local bourbon micro lot from Long Miles Coffee Project would be a safe bet. They've been refining their anaerobic processing for years resulting in a cup that's fruity, floral and flavorful with a clean, smooth finish. We noted gentle nectarine, apricot, honey, apple juice and black tea with a fragrant floral undertone.

coffees.title: Burundi Muyinga Gashoho Natural
coffees.description: Royal Crown Jewel! We've been SO excited for Burundi coffee to return and this offering is a great example of why! If you're a fan of natural processed Ethiopian coffee, you'll love this one too. This year's particular lot features more candy sweet flavors, such as watermelon candy, strawberry jam, and orange juice along with milk chocolate.

coffees.title: Burundi Ngozi Bahire Washed
coffees.description: This Royal Crown Jewel is like a medley of the most popular coffee flavors and attributes you’ll experience across fully washed coffees in Africa. From Kenya there’s a slight white wine character, found most notably in the dry, tannic finish. From Ethiopia, we get a tea-like, silky body with notes of bergamot, plum and jasmine. And from both we’ve got crisp acidity and delicate sweetness.

coffees.title: Burundi Ngozi Bavyeyi Natural
coffees.description: This delicious coffee comes to us from JNP coffee, which is doing incredible work with the producers of Burundi. This particular lot is a natural with a lengthy processing time, making for a slightly more mild and accessible cup than you'd find in a comparable Ethiopian natural. It's zesty and juicy with notes of orange, raspberry, pineapple and dark cherry. Arrival Date: March 12th, 2021 Acidity & Brightness…

coffees.title: Burundi Ngozi Turihamwe
coffees.description: This delightful coffee comes to us from JNP Coffee, an incredible organization that is going amazing things for the farmers of Burundi. And they can produce a heck of a cuppa! This bright and delicate coffee is very balanced and clean with notes of apple cider, caramel, peach and lemongrass. Arrival Date: March 12th, 2021 Acidity & Brightness: Bright and delicately sweet Balance & Finish: Very balanced, clean…

coffees.title: Burundi Ubuto-Karuzi Washed
coffees.description: This fully washed microlot from JNP does an amazing job of showcasing Burundi's local Bourbon varieties. The cup is delightfully clean and balanced and fairly bright with flavors of fresh papaya and peach, zesty lime, and a nutty sweet flavor of marzipan. It's easy drinkin' and refreshing with a full body and a quick, clean finish.

coffees.title: Colombia Bundle
coffees.description: We've got in 4 amazing Colombian coffees representing a wide variety of cultivars and flavors! This convenient bundle features a pound of all 4 at a discount so you can try them all. Regions: Huila & Tolima, Colombia Varietals: Gesha (Geisha) | A blend of Pink, Red & Yellow Bourbon | Pacamara | A regional blend of Bourbon, Caturra, Castillo, Colombia, Gesha, F8, and Tabi Roasting: All four perform well for us in…

coffees.title: Colombia Cesár El Rubi Estate Organic
coffees.description: This single estate coffee is our first from the Cesár region and now that we've tried it, it won't be our last! Surprisingly soft and sweet for a Colombian, it's easy drinking and sure to be a crowd pleaser. Balanced and creamy with notes of caramel, pomegranate, green apple and biscuit. Arrival Date: August 17th, 2021 Acidity & Brightness: Moderate, gentle acidity, very sweet Balance & Finish: Balanced with a…

coffees.title: Colombia DECAF Natural
coffees.description: It's sweet, fruity and refreshingly clean with juicy notes of blueberry, strawberry, mango, lime and clementine. A real fruit bomb!

coffees.title: Colombia Del Rio Tolima Organic
coffees.description: This organic selection from the Tolima region of Colombia features a rich body and creamy texture with juicy notes of orange, cherry and raw sugar. Extremely balanced and smooth, sure to please! Arrival Date: ﻿March 24th, 2017 Acidity & Brightness: Moderately bright, very sweet and juicy Balance & Finish: Extremely balanced, smooth finish Body & Texture: Medium to rich bodied, creamy texture Flavors: Orange, cherry…

coffees.title: Colombia EA Decaf

coffees.title: Colombia Finca Las Nubes Pink Bourbon
coffees.description: Step into the world of Colombia Finca Las Nubes Pink Bourbon from Claudia Samboni, where elegance meets complexity in every cup. coffees.title: Colombia Honey Aponte
