coffees.title: Ethiopia Guji Dur Feres Natural Organic
coffees.description: Named in honor of the iconic Harrar Horse brand, Dur Feres means "Wild Horse" in Amharic. We think this community blend is an excellent representation of that heritage. It's fruity, sweet and silky with notes of fresh ripe strawberry and cranberry as well lovely hibiscus and rose.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Guji Natural Royal Select Water Decaf
coffees.description: ﻿This Royal Crown Jewel decaf is a rare treat! It's not often we get to enjoy natural processed Ethiopian coffee in decaf form so we were excited to see this one join the lineup. As a natural processed coffee, it represents the fruitiest of our decaf offerings with notes of peach, clementine, dried berries and even a smattering of banana along with rich maple and pastry notes for added texture.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Guji Tsebel Washed Organic
coffees.description: ﻿This delightful coffee is the fully washed sister coffee to Catalyst Trade's Dur Feres community lot program. It's crisp and incredibly clean with harmonious balance. Look for delicate notes of jasmine, lilac, peach, lemon zest and cane sugar.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Guji Uraga Grade 1 Natural
coffees.description: This regional blend from Feku Jiberil has been carefully processed and sorted to Grade 1 to highlight what makes the heirloom beans of Ethiopia such a prize. Our cupping notes could be summarized as simply "fruity pebbles." Notes of strawberry, blueberry and cherry with a cinnamon and nutmeg undertone, reminiscent of granola. It’s silky, surprisingly clean and intensely sweet.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Guji Wush Wush 120 Hour Natural
coffees.description: Our first berry bomb of the year! This wush wush from the small village of Hambela in the Guji region was fermented for 120 hours before natural processing to bring out all the juicy, fruity flavor. In the cup, we got big notes of blackberry and strawberry along with boozy sangria and a hint of cacao nibs and lemon frosting.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Keffa Wush Wush Black Honey
coffees.description: Like natural processed coffee but wish it had just a bit more brightness and balance? This Black Honey Wush Wush is for you. It's got notes of juicy sweet champagne grapes, luxurious clover honey, crisp orange peel and a dash of cardamom for good measure.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Keffa Wush Wush Limited Oxygen Natural
coffees.description: This coffee is everything you've ever wanted out of a natural processed Ethiopian coffee with a little extra you didn't know you needed. Limited Oxygen is similar to Anaerobic Fermentation, only cleaner and without all the boozy bite we associate with cheap wine. It's bursting with big notes of ripe blackberries, elderberry juice, grape soda and passionflower.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Keffa Wush Wush Red Honey
coffees.description: We just can't get enough Wush Wush! This Red Honey processed lot shows what happens when you combine the fruitiness of natural with the bright florals of washed. It's balanced and clean with notes of pink apple, golden raisin, honeycomb, iris and lemon peel.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Kochere Bonde Yeast Fermentation
coffees.description: If you're new to yeast fermented coffee, I can assure you this coffee doesn't taste at all "yeasty"! All yeast does is make coffee's normal fermentation process more controlled and focused. This Grade 1 Kochere is a perfect example: super clean, floral and tea-like with a dash of vanilla and passion fruit sweetness.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Sidama Bensa Keramo Washed
coffees.description: The Bombe mountains produce some of the most flavor dense coffees of anywhere in Ethiopia. This washed selection from the tiny village of Keramo proves that washed Ethiopian coffee doesn't have to be one-dimensional. It's dynamic and full of flavor with notes of juicy mandarin orange, ripe peach, candied ginger, key lime and elderflower.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Sidama Bombe Abdosh Natural Organic
coffees.description: It's back, the berry bomb from Bombe! This single estate coffee comes from a newcomer who's looking to make waves in Sidama: Faysel Abdosh. He's produced an absolutely stellar cup chock full of berry flavors with a dash of anise and a lingering cereal finish.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Sidama Bombe Daniso Horsa Natural
coffees.description: A fresh berry bomb from Bombe! This single farm selection comes to us from farmer Daniso Horsa and it's so exclusive, only 100 bags are produced yearly. As we've come to expect with excellent Bombes, it's an intensely sweet cup with gentle brightness and a clean finish. Obviously we tasted lots of berry, including blackberry and blueberry as well as ripe peach and syrupy mango.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Sidama Durato Bombe Kontama Natural
coffees.description: A fresh berry bomb from Bombe! Sourced at the Kontama mill from small farmers on the slopes of Bombe Mountain, this coffee has everything we look for in coffees bearing that name. It's complex but still manages a lovely clean finish. Boldly juicy, intensely sweet and full bodied. We got jammy notes of blueberry and blackberry with an accompaniment of papaya, milk chocolate all with a winey undertone.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Sidama Natural Organic Water Decaf
coffees.description: This Royal Select water processed decaf is a breath of fresh air! While many decafs are bland and boring, this coffee has been hand selected to keep all the amazing flavors of natural processed Ethiopian coffee intact through the decaffeination process and bursting into the cup. Creamy and complex with notes of black currant, blueberry, cocoa and cinnamon. Arrival Date: ﻿December 10th, 2020 Acidity & Brightness…

coffees.title: Ethiopia Sidama Shakiso Natural Decaf
coffees.description: This lot was hand selected for Decaf processing from the harvest of smallholders in Shakiso village to showcase the heirloom profile of the Sidama region without all the caffeine. It's silky smooth and gently sweet with notes of berry, plum, brown sugar and and undertone of baker's chocolate.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Sidama Worku Buche Washed Decaf
coffees.description: This fully washed decaf was hand selected by Worku Buche at his Kadela washing station in Sidama's Arroresa district. It's balanced, clean and gently bright. Along with a lovely floral tone we noted plum, cinnamon and warm vanilla. It's a tasty treat on a cool fall evening!

Bright and very sweet, expect notes of blueberry, pineapple, plum and lingering brown sugar. coffees.title: Ethiopia Washed YirgZ
coffees.description: Yirg refers to Yirgacheffe and Z indicates the minimal to zero defects present in the coffee. Keffa employs a method of triple sorting by size, color, and then density. This additional sorting not only benefits the end cup result but also the producer's staff, as they are paid more for the intense sorting process. coffees.title: Ethiopia West Arsi Adem Haro Bararto Natural
coffees.description: Captain's Gold top 6! This Cup of Excellent Jury Selection represents our first offering from the West Arsi sub region of Oromia. West Arsi borders the much more famous region of Sidama and often goes overlooked, but this selection proves it can produce world class coffee. It's sweet, clean, silky and slightly tangy with notes of raspberry, lemonade, nectarine and cocoa powder with just a dab of blueberry.

Jammy, juicy and intensely sweet with big notes of raspberry, strawberry and hints of jasmine and melon. Note this is a different lot from Bedhatu than our previous Crown Jewel lot, though it is from the same harvest. Arrival Date: April…

coffees.title: Ethiopia Yirgacheffe Biloya Natural
coffees.description: This grade 1 natural processed Yirgacheffe comes to us from the Biloya washing station. While the fruitiness is more subdued compared to other naturals from the region, it's got surprising depth and lovely complexity which reminds us of coffee from Yemen. A more "classical" heirloom profile than the fruit bombs we've featured lately. We noted raspberry jam, peach tea, graham cracker and demerara sugar in the cup.

coffees.title: Ethiopia Yirgacheffe Wush Wush 96 Hour Anaerobic Natural
coffees.description: This microlot from renowned coffee expert Israel Degafa comes from producers in Yirgacheffe. At his washing station, Israel uses a proprietary anaerobic fermentation protocol he's dubbed "alcoholic" due to the crisp, winey cups it produces. It's also juicy and sweet with big notes of strawberry, blackberry, banana, lemonade and pure cane sugar.

coffees.title: Flores Bajawa Ngura Organic
coffees.description: New crop just in - this fantastic coffee from Indonesia features low acidity with a huge body and syrupy texture. An accompaniment of fudge, maple, vanilla bean and black cherry make this coffee an indulgent treat! One of our all time favorite Indonesian coffees and it's great for roasting dark.

coffees.title: Fruit BOMB Blend
coffees.description: Summer's here and the time is RIPE for a fruit bomb! Whether you're looking for a delightfully fruity morning pick me up or an iced afternoon refresher, our fruit bomb blend is sure to suit your needs. It's (of course) fruity, juicy and sweet with notes of raspberry, strawberry, tangerine, chocolate and just a dash of spice.

coffees.description: This coffee is a hyper-selective blend of cherry from 2 local Antigua estates developed by expert exporter Los Volcanes. It's rich, velvety and almost buttery with mild acidity. The flavor profile is bold and slightly complex with notes of dark chocolate, walnut, brown sugar and grape.

You get a big, rich bodied cup balanced with mellow brightness and sweetness. We enjoyed notes of plum, vanilla cola, almond, and dark chocolate.

The cherries are selectively hand-picked at peak ripeness and carefully sorted before being…

coffees.title: Sulawesi Rantekarua Estate Organic
coffees.description: This single estate coffee is unusual for Sulawesi as it is fully washed! Expect the same big, syrupy body but with surprising balance! We love the notes of sweet (but not too sweet) butterscotch, molasses and cocoa powder. Arrival Date: August 29th, 2019 Acidity & Brightness: Low acidity, surprisingly crisp for an Indonesian coffee Balance & Finish: Fairly balanced, clean, quick finish Body & Texture: Bold, rich…

coffees.title: Sulawesi Toraja Bolokon Natural Organic
coffees.producer: Rantekarua Estate managed by PT Sulotco Jaya Abadi
coffees.description: This coffee comes from one of our favorite Indonesian estates: Rantekarua. Rantekarua is a leader in coffee innovation in the region and have extended their selections to include this delicious natural processed offering. It's tangy, sweet and intense with a surprisingly clean finish. Look for notes of guava, pineapple, blackberry & cocoa. Arrival Date: February 11th, 2022 Acidity & Brightness: Slightly tangy and…

coffees.title: Sulawesi Toraja Sapan-Minanga
coffees.description: One of the highest grown coffees in Indonesia, Sapan-Minanga is unusually crisp, while still possessing the luxuriously rich body you expect from a Sulawesi coffee. It's like Sumatra's more refined and sophisticated friend!

coffees.title: Sulawesi Toraja Sesean Sapan Organic
coffees.description: The highest grown coffees in Indonesia come from Sulawesi and the altitude makes for a very clean cup! This crop features very low acidity, huge body and notes of baker's chocolate, cedar and vanilla. Arrival Date: February 18th, 2020 Acidity & Brightness: Low acidity, quite sweet Balance & Finish: Slightly complex with a lingering, sweet woody finish Body & Texture: Bold, rich body and syrupy texture Flavors…

coffees.title: Sumatra Aceh Buana Mandiri Organic
coffees.description: From one of the top producing regions of Sumatra, the Aceh region, comes an Organic coffee that will blow your socks off! Rich and syrupy with smokey hints of baker's chocolate, cedar and black pepper. Arrival Date: July 23rd, 2018 Acidity & Brightness: Low acidity with a smokey bite Balance & Finish: Complex with a lingering finish Body & Texture: Big, rich body and syrupy texture Flavors: Baker's chocolate, cedar…

coffees.title: Sumatra Aceh Gayo Ketiara Organic
coffees.description: This bold, rich coffee comes to us from the women-run Ketiara Cooperative. While it's just as big and complex as other wet-hulled offerings, their meticulous Grade 1 processing provides an unusually clean and crisp cup. Look for notes of dark chocolate, cedar, vanilla, & anise.

coffees.title: Sumatra Aceh Ketiara Adsenia Organic
coffees.description: This Sumatra Aceh is triple picked for consistency and quality. It's got an earthy spiciness accompanied by notes of baker's chocolate, cedar, pipe tobacco and a syrupy body. Arrival Date: April 28th, 2016 ﻿Acidity & Brightness: ﻿Low acidity, sweet Balance & Finish: Syrupy Mouthfeel and Long Finish Body & Texture: Compex Full Body, Flavors: Baker's chocolate, cedar and pipe tobacco Grade: Hard and Dense Processing…

coffees.title: Sumatra Aceh Permata Gayo Mandheling
coffees.description: This Grade 1 offering comes to us from the Permata Gayo coop in the highlands of Aceh. It checks all the boxes we look for in a great Sumatran coffee: bold, rich, syrupy and earthy complexity, what more could you ask for? In the cup we got notes of luxurious pipe tobacco, toasted marshmallow, cacao nibs, a dash of pepper and even a touch of ripe plum.

coffees.title: Sumatra Kerinci Gunung Tujuh
coffees.description: This offering from the ALKO Coop exemplifies the classic wet-hulled Sumatran profile. It's got muted acidity and a huge, syrupy body along with a lingering, earthy finish. As you'd expect, the flavor profile is complex and spicy with notes of licorice, anise and molasses accompanied by a bit of mango.

coffees.title: Sumatra Kerinci Honey
coffees.description: Forget everything you know about Sumatran coffee. The producers of this offering have combined two different types of semi-washed processing, honey processing and wet-hulling, to create something completely new. It's kept the syrupy texture and moderate acidity we know and love from Indonesian coffee and combined it with the fruity, juicy flavors commonly found in honey and natural processed coffee. Look for big…

coffees.title: Sumatra Mandheling Grade 1
coffees.description: A classic Indonesian coffee with tons of syrupy body and complex, spicy flavor. Superb as all on its own and a fantastic addition to any West Coast style espresso blend, it's got a smokey bite and notes of baker's chocolate, peat moss, cedar and a hint of black pepper. Arrival Date: January 12th, 2022 Acidity & Brightness: Low acidity with a smokey bite Balance & Finish: Complex with a lingering finish Body &…

coffees.title: Sumatra Mandheling Sara Ate Organic
coffees.description: This fair trade and organic offering from the Sara Ate Coop is the classic wet-hulled Indonesian cup. It's got low acidity, a syrupy body and smokey/spicy notes such as dark chocolate, pipe tobacco, licorice and black pepper. Bold, delicious and rumored to cause spontaneous chest hair growth. Arrival Date: August 17th, 2021 Acidity & Brightness: Low acidity with a smokey sweetness Balance & Finish: Complex with a…

coffees.title: Sumatra Ratu Ketiara Mandheling Organic
coffees.description: This bold, rich coffee comes to us from the women-led Ratu Ketiara Gayo Cooperative (RKG). While it's just as big and complex as other wet-hulled offerings, their meticulous Grade 1 processing provides an unusually clean and crisp cup. Look for notes of marshmallow, vanilla, cedar, anise and dark chocolate.

coffees.title: Sumatra Royal Select Swiss Water Decaf
coffees.description: One of the richest decafs around, this coffee again proves that if you start with great beans, you can produce great decaf. We love the rich, syrupy body and notes of dark chocolate and smokey oak with a touch of spice and savory herbs.

coffees.title: Sumatra Takengon Organic Fair Trade
coffees.description: This is a classic example of great Sumatran coffee. It's got a rich, syrupy body, low acidity a complex profile of baker's chocolate, pipe tobacco, spice and vanilla. Perfect for milk and sugar since those bold flavors will cut right through! Arrival Date: September 9th, 2016 Acidity & Brightness: Low acidity, warm and spicy Balance & Finish: Complex and lingering finish Body & Texture: Syrupy body with a creamy…

coffees.title: Sumatra Wahana Estate Natural
coffees.description: A unique Sumatran coffee that's dry (natural) processed! It's fruity, exotic and earthy with notes of candied watermelon and strawberry and earthy spice. Arrival Date: December 11, 2015 Acidity & Brightness: Moderate acidity, very sweet Balance & Finish: Juicy, and Fruity but retains earthy Indonesian characteristics Body & Texture: Medium to Full Body, Flavors: N otes of candied watermelon, strawberry and earthy…

coffees.title: Tanzania Finagro Ascona Anaerobic Maceration
coffees.description: This exciting selection comes from Finagro Ascona Estate, owned by the Vohora family. It's processed in a relatively new and increasingly popular method called Anaerobic Maceration. This process imparts a "spicy-ness" to the coffee along with highlighting funky and fruity flavors already present in the bean. Look for notes of honeydew and tropical fruit mixed with cinnamon and nutmeg. Arrival Date: ﻿March 12th…

coffees.title: Tanzania Kilimanjaro Estate Peaberry
coffees.description: ﻿﻿This bright and balanced peaberry comes to us from the family owned Ngila Estate. This coffee is sure to be a crowd pleaser with sweet notes of nectarine, caramel and milk chocolate along with rich almond butter. Not to mention, it's a fun and easy coffee to roast!

coffees.title: Tanzania Mbeya Peaberry
coffees.description: Selected from family farms in the Mbeya region, this offering is delightfully sweet with a gentle herbal accompaniment. Silky and easy drinking, look for notes of lemonade, caramel, hibiscus and green apple. Arrival Date: ﻿October 16th, 2020 Acidity & Brightness: Bright and crisp but also very sweet Balance & Finish: Balanced with a lingering, sweet finish Body & Texture: Medium bodied, smooth, silky texture…

coffees.title: Tanzania Ngorongoro Finagro Estate Citric Carbonic
coffees.description: This micro lot from Neel and Kavita Vohora brings a LOT to the table and it’s also our very first co-fermented offering! They have developed a unique processing method which they call “Citric Carbonic”. Despite the intense fermentation, this coffee is exceptionally clean. It's full of big citrus flavors most notably orange, along with tangy pineapple, fresh kiwi, raspberry, and hibiscus. It's refreshing, silky…

coffees.title: Tanzania Ngorongoro Finagro Estate Peaberry
coffees.description: Tanzanian Peaberry has become a household name in the specialty coffee world. Despite making up only 5-10% of coffee cherries harvested, this little naturally occurring mutation is in higher demand than all other sorting sizes. This is a single estate peaberry lot from the Vohora siblings! It’s super clean with crisp acidity and excellent balance. It’s got a medium to full body with a smooth, silky texture. The…

coffees.title: Tanzania Northern Peaberry
coffees.description: This classic Tanzanian Peaberry is grown near the country's northern border with Kenya and you can taste some of the similarities. Crisp and just slightly wine-y, it's got balanced flavors of milk chocolate and tangerine with a hint of lime. Arrival Date: ﻿April 20th, 2018 Acidity & Brightness: Bright and crisp but without a bite Balance & Finish: Balanced with a clean, sweet finish Body & Texture: Medium bodied…

coffees.title: Tanzania Northern Peaberry Plus
coffees.description: This classic Tanzanian Peaberry is a grade above the rest (thus the "Plus"). It's bright and crisp with a sweet finish and smooth texture. Look for notes of dark chocolate, lime and a hint of raspberry. Arrival Date: ﻿April 14th, 2017 Acidity & Brightness: Bright and crisp but without a bite Balance & Finish: Balanced with a clean, sweet finish Body & Texture: Medium bodied, smooth texture Flavors: Dark chocolate…

coffees.title: Tanzania Nyasi Furaha Peaberry
coffees.description: This tasty offering from Southern Tanzania is an excellent representation of the classic Tanzania Peaberry profile. It's got gentle citric acidity, silky texture and subtle sweetness along with excellent balance and a clean, slightly floral finish. A very subtle coffee, don’t expect a blast of flavor! We noted lemon zest, buttery almond and amaretto, cherries, milk chocolate and a black tea undertone.

coffees.title: Tanzania Peaberry Kuza Tudley
coffees.description: This single estate Tanzanian Peaberry is absolutely delightful. It's bright and crisp with a sweet finish and smooth texture. Look for notes of lime, honey and clementine. Arrival Date: ﻿February 8th, 2019 Acidity & Brightness: Bright and crisp but without a bite Balance & Finish: Balanced with a clean, sweet finish Body & Texture: Medium bodied, smooth, silky texture Flavors: Lime, honey and clementine Grade…

coffees.title: Tanzania Peaberry Selian Estate
coffees.description: From Burka Coffee Producers comes this single estate treat. It's crisp and bright as well as balanced with a clean finish. Look for notes of cocoa powder, lemon and lime. Arrival Date: ﻿August 29th, 2019 Acidity & Brightness: Bright and crisp but without a bite Balance & Finish: Balanced with a clean, sweet finish Body & Texture: Medium bodied, smooth texture Flavors: Cocoa powder, lemon and lime Grade: Peaberry…

coffees.title: Tanzania Ruvuma AA
coffees.description: Sweet, balanced and silky. Although Tanzania is famous for peaberry, this is a flat bean and fans of peaberry will find the profiles similar but a bit more flavor forward and pronounced. Arrival Date: January 26th, 2018 Acidity & Brightness: Moderately bright and crisp Balance & Finish: Well balanced, lingering finish Body & Texture: Medium to full bodied, silky smooth texture. Flavors: Black tea, peach, tangerine…

coffees.title: The Captain's Feliz Navidad Organic Blend
coffees.description: This year we're keeping our Holiday Blend all in the family. That means we're blending our favorites from our direct trade and organic family farms into a tasty cup perfect for sharing with your family! It's rich, syrupy and full of warm winter flavors like cocoa, brown sugar, raspberry and cranberry with just a touch of baking spices and roasted walnuts. Feliz Navidad amigos!

coffees.title: The Captain's Half-Caf Organic Blend
coffees.description: Enjoy sipping delicious direct trade and organic coffee all day long with only half the caffeine! Based on our award-winning honey decaf, this blend is bold, rich, creamy and suited to all brewing styles. Expect notes of dark chocolate, maple, peach and walnut.

coffees.title: The Captain's Holiday Blend
coffees.description: Our favorite time of year demands our most ambitious blend yet! With 5 constituent coffees spanning all 3 major coffee growing regions and 4 different processing methods, our Holiday Blend delivers with our interpretation of everything that makes the Holidays wonderful. It's rich, bold and flavorful with notes of dark chocolate, cherry cordial, tangerine and mulling spices. Designed to suit all brew methods, it…

coffees.title: The Captain's House Blend
coffees.description: Our go-to, all purpose house blend. Big body, low acidity and smooth texture, it's sure to suit just about any coffee lover!

coffees.title: The Captain's Italian Blend
coffees.description: Experience the bold intensity, decadent chocolate undertones, and irresistibly smooth finish that define this classic espresso. Savor Italian coffee craftsmanship with every sip.

coffees.title: The Captain's Rico Amanecer Organic Blend
coffees.description: Awaken your senses with The Captain’s Rico Amanecer Organic Blend , a carefully crafted organic coffee designed to capture the warmth and promise of a new sunrise. "Amanecer," meaning sunrise, reflects the character of this blend comforting, vibrant, and full of life from the first sip to the last. This medium bodied blend delivers a warm, rich, and syrupy mouthfeel that coats the palate with exceptional sweetness…

coffees.title: Timor-Leste Ermera Assui Kraik Organic
coffees.description: High quality coffee from Timor-Leste (also known as East Timor) is a rare treat. At it's best, East Timorese coffee is like a blend of Indonesian coffee and Central American coffee. It's rich, warm and velvety yet crisp, balanced and fruity. Look for big notes of milk chocolate along with toffee, melon and peach.

coffees.title: Timor-Leste Ermera Ducurai Lacau Organic
coffees.description: Royal Crown Jewel! This Farmgate coffee from Timor-Leste (also known as East Timor) is a rare treat. At it's best, East Timorese coffee is as rich as wet-hulled Indonesian coffee and as clean and balanced as washed Central American coffee. It's rich, warm and velvety with mild acidity and great balance. Look for big caramely notes of butterscotch with red apple, black cherry and milk chocolate.

coffees.title: Timor-Leste Ermera Lebudu Kraik Organic
coffees.description: This Farmgate coffee is one of two fine selections from the Ducurai village of Timor-Leste (also known as East Timor) that we've chosen from this season's harvest. At it's best, East Timorese coffee is like a blend of Indonesian coffee and Central American coffee. It's rich, warm and velvety yet balanced and clean. This particular offering is like a dark chocolate brownie mixed with candied blood orange. Absolutely…

coffees.title: Uganda Bugisu Organic
coffees.description: Lower acidity than most East African coffees, Bugisu is deeply flavored, brooding, rich and heavier in body with notes of dark chocolate, molasses and coconut followed by a dry finish. Great at full medium roast but also takes dark roasts very well. Arrival Date: October 9th, 2020 Acidity & Brightness: Mild Acidity, moderately bright Balance & Finish: Slightly complex with a lingering, dry finish (think red wine)…

coffees.title: Uganda Bukonzo Organic
coffees.description: This organic and fair trade selection from the Bukonzo Coop is a standout among East African coffees. It almost has more in common with Indonesian coffee so expect a big body, buttery texture and notes of cocoa, brown sugar and raisin. Arrival Date: ﻿April 1st, 2020 Acidity & Brightness: Mild Acidity, moderately bright Balance & Finish: Slightly complex with a lingering, dry finish (think red wine) Body & Texture…

coffees.title: Uganda Friends of Mothers Organic
coffees.description: Founded in 2015, the Friends of Mothers Initiative is empowering women farmers in Uganda to bring top shelf coffee to a world market. This amazing coffee is low acid, super rich and almost syrupy. Look for complex notes of cocoa, raisin and molasses. Arrival Date: February 14th, 2020 Acidity & Brightness: Low acidity, slightly sweet Balance & Finish: Complex with a lingering, dry finish Body & Texture: Rich Body…

coffees.title: Uganda Mbale Crown Jewel Bundle
coffees.subregion: Yilwanako, Buginyanya, Bushiyi, Makali, Bukalasi and Sipi
coffees.description: Both of our offerings from Uganda were made Crown Jewels by Royal Coffee! Both are also microlots from Mountain Harvest's Mbale. One is a honey process and the other is fully washed making for an excellent comparison. Region: Yilwanako, Buginyanya, Bushiyi, Makali, Bukalasi and Sipi communities, Mt. Elgon, Uganda Varietals: SL-14, Nyasaland Roasting: Both coffees perform well at Full Medium which would be a great…

coffees.title: Uganda Mountain Harvest Mbale Honey Organic
coffees.description: This Royal Crown Jewel selection proves that Ugandan coffee has been overlooked for far too long. This offering, along with it's Fully Washed twin , has been immaculately sorted and processed to deliver a cup that's bold, flavorful and clean. We enjoyed notes of juicy blackberry, grape and persimmon with a winey kick and a hibiscus undertone.

coffees.title: Uganda Mountain Harvest Mbale Washed Organic
coffees.description: This Royal Crown Jewel selection proves that Ugandan coffee has been overlooked for far too long. This offering, along with it's Honey Processed twin , has been immaculately sorted and processed to deliver a cup that's bold, flavorful and clean. We tasted balanced notes of grape, nectarine, milk chocolate and amaretto.

coffees.title: Uganda Mountain Harvest Organic
coffees.description: Have you ever wanted a coffee with the flavor and depth of an African coffee but the body, texture and complexity of an Indonesian coffee? Do you like medium to dark roasts? This coffee is for you. Mountain Harvest has offered the heights of Mt. Elgon in this lot and you'll taste it in every sip. Rich, syrupy, and slightly complex with mild acidity. Notes of butterscotch, pineapple and candied ginger. Arrival Date…

coffees.title: Uganda Sipi Falls Honey Organic
coffees.producer: Producers organized around the Sipi Falls washing station
coffees.description: This is our second Crown Jewel from Sipi Falls, they must be doing something right! This honey processed lot is rich and creamy with a delightfully complex compliment of flavors. While honey lots from the Americas tend to showcase intense fruity sweetness, this one is surprisingly warm with notes of molasses, apricot, cherry cola and cocoa finished with toffee and spice. Arrival Date: November 12th, 2021 Acidity &…

coffees.title: Uganda Sipi Falls Kapkwai Natural Organic
coffees.description: This Royal Crown Jewel offering is absolutely mind-blowing. Intensely complex when fresh roasted, it evolves with rest into a surprisingly balanced and approachable cup. A decadently rich and velvety body gives way to a sweet and juicy cup with big notes of grape and peach along with notes of apricot, honey and vanilla followed by a warm pecan finish. Arrival Date: December 10th, 2020 Acidity & Brightness: Moderate…

coffees.title: Uganda Sipi Falls Washed Organic
coffees.description: Ugandan coffee falls into an unusual niche as far as African coffee goes. In its fully washed form the closest neighbor in profile is probably Kenya but it shares more characteristics with coffees you might find in Indonesia and South America. This particular selection is balanced, rich and velvety with moderate acidity. It’s warm and inviting with notes of dark chocolate, caramel, raisin, graham cracker and a just…

coffees.title: Yemen Mocca Kholani Natural
coffees.producer: Assorted farmers organized around Muslot Trading Stores
coffees.description: Kholani coffee is in a class of it's own, even within the unique origin of Yemen. It's a term of terroir distinction, similar to “Kona”, that refers to high-quality heirloom coffee varieties produced in the unique climate and soil of Yemen’s northern ranges. Kh o lani coffee is widely regarded in Yemen as one of its best and most historic. It's got A syrupy body, moderate acidity and a very heavy, almost 1/2 and…

coffees.title: Yemen Mocca Pearl of Tehama Natural
coffees.description: Coffee from Yemen has a depth and complexity that's difficult to describe, so one cup of this delicious Mocca is worth a thousand words. It's got sweet notes of tangerine and raspberry counterbalanced with gently spiced granola and bittersweet chocolate. And if you like syrupy, weighty coffees with low acidity, this one is a treat.

coffees.title: Zimbabwe Smaldeel Estate AA
coffees.description: Our first coffee from Zimbabwe! This season's crop is bright and crisp with notes of peach, rhubarb and a touch of caramel and lime zest.
